We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

cud.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

cue.en: And the men of Babylon made Succothbenoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

cumber.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?
But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me.

cumbrance.en: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

cummin.en: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

cunning.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

cunningly.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

cup.en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

cupbearer.en: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of the LORD; there was no more spirit in her.

cur.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil; and he departed out of him: and the child was cured from that very hour.
The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed.

curdle.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

cure.en: And I brought him to thy disciples, and they could not cure him.
Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.

curious.en: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
And thou shalt take the garments, and put upon Aaron the coat, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastplate, and gird him with the curious girdle of the ephod:

curiously.en: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

current.en: And Abraham hearkened unto Ephron; and Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver, which he had named in the audience of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, current money with the merchant.

curse.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

cursed.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed.

curtain.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.
I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

custody.en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

So it came to pass, when the king’s commandment and his decree was heard, and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace, to the custody of Hegai, that Esther was brought also unto the king’s house, to the custody of Hegai, keeper of the women.

custom.en: And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast.
But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

cut.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

cutting.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people, and hast sinned against thy soul.
And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

cymbal.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

cypress.en: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.

cyprus.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
So they, being sent forth by the Holy Ghost, departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus.

cyrenian.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.

dagger.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.

dagon.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.

daily.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
Give us day by day our daily bread.

dainty.en: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

dale.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer, and of the kings that were with him, at the valley of Shaveh, which is the king’s dale.

Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.

dam.en: Likewise shalt thou do with thine oxen, and with thy sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day thou shalt give it me.
But thou shalt in any wise let the dam go, and take the young to thee; that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days.

damage.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
Take heed now that ye fail not to do this: why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings?

damascene.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

damascus.en: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
Whereupon as I went to Damascus with authority and commission from the chief priests,

damnable.en: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

damnation.en: Having damnation, because they have cast off their first faith.
Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

damned.en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned.
That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

damsel.en: And they said, We will call the damsel, and enquire at her mouth.
And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

dan.en: And the sons of Dan; Hushim.
Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

dance.en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

dancing.en: Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard musick and dancing.
Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

dandle.en: For thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.

danger.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation:
Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time, Thou shalt not kill; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment:

dangerous.en: Now when much time was spent, and when sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was now already past, Paul admonished them,

daniel.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

danite.en: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

dare.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

dark.en: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.
In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

darken.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

darkish.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

darkly.en: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

darkness.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

darling.en: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

dart.en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

dash.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

daub.en: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:

daubing.en: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?

daughter.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

dawn.en: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.
Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

day.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
Give us day by day our daily bread.

daysman.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

dayspring.en: Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high hath visited us,
Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

daytime.en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

deacon.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
And let these also first be proved; then let them use the office of a deacon, being found blameless.

dead.en: But God raised him from the dead:
For he that is dead is freed from sin.

deadly.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

deadness.en: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah’s womb:

deaf.en: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

deal.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

dealer.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

dealing.en: And he said unto them, Why do ye such things? for I hear of your evil dealings by all this people.
His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

dear.en: Be ye therefore followers of God, as dear children;
And a certain centurion’s servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die.

dearly.en: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

dearth.en: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.

death.en: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

debase.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.

debate.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

debt.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

debtor.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

decay.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

decayed.en: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:

decease.en: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

deceased.en: Now there were with us seven brethren: and the first, when he had married a wife, deceased, and, having no issue, left his wife unto his brother:
They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.

deceit.en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

deceitful.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.

deceitfully.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

deceitfulness.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

deceivableness.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

deceive.en: Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?
Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

deceiver.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;

decided.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there, he was gone. And the king of Israel said unto him, So shall thy judgment be; thyself hast decided it.

decision.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.

deck.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

declaration.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us,

declare.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

decline.en: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

declined.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

decrease.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

decree.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

dedicate.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.

dedication.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication, and it was winter.
And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

deed.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

deem.en: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in Adria, about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;

deep.en: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:

deeply.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

deepness.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:

deer.en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

defame.en: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

defeat.en: But if thou return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be thy servant, O king; as I have been thy father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be thy servant: then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

And Absalom and all the men of Israel said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For the LORD had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that the LORD might bring evil upon Absalom.

defence.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
But the LORD is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

defend.en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
The LORD hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

defer.en: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
When thou vowest a vow unto God, defer not to pay it; for he hath no pleasure in fools: pay that which thou hast vowed.

defile.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.
Then I saw that she was defiled, that they took both one way,

defraud.en: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
Receive us; we have wronged no man, we have corrupted no man, we have defrauded no man.

defy.en: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.

degenerate.en: Yet I had planted thee a noble vine, wholly a right seed: how then art thou turned into the degenerate plant of a strange vine unto me?

degree.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
He hath put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree.

delay.en: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.
But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

delectable.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

delicate.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.
Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

delicately.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

delicateness.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

deliciously.en: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

delight.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

delighted.en: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

delightsome.en: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land, saith the LORD of hosts.

delilah.en: And it came to pass afterward, that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
And Delilah said unto Samson, Behold, thou hast mocked me, and told me lies: now tell me, I pray thee, wherewith thou mightest be bound.

deliver.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.
For he knew that the chief priests had delivered him for envy.

deliverance.en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

deliverer.en: And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.

delivery.en: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O LORD.

delusion.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie:

I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.

demand.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.

demonstration.en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

den.en: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

denounce.en: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

deny.en: And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not.
Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.

depart.en: So Paul departed from among them.
And he arose, and departed to his house.

departure.en: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall; yea, the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure.

depose.en: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

deprive.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.

depth.en: Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O LORD.
The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

depute.en: And Absalom said unto him, See, thy matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee.

deputy.en: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord.

deride.en: And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him.
And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

derision.en: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.
The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

descend.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

descending.en: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

descent.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

describe.en: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

description.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts, and bring the description hither to me, that I may cast lots for you here before the LORD our God.

descry.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

desert.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.

deserve.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

And after all that is come upon us for our evil deeds, and for our great trespass, seeing that thou our God hast punished us less than our iniquities deserve, and hast given us such deliverance as this;

deserving.en: Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

desirable.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours, captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding upon horses, all of them desirable young men.

desire.en: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

desirous.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

desolate.en: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

desolation.en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

despair.en: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
Therefore I went about to cause my heart to despair of all the labour which I took under the sun.

desperate.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

desperately.en: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

despise.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

despiser.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
Behold, ye despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which ye shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you.

despite.en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thou hast clapped thine hands, and stamped with the feet, and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel;

Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of God, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

despiteful.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

destitute.en: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

destroy.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

destroyer.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

destruction.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

detain.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the LORD, I pray thee, let us detain thee, until we shall have made ready a kid for thee.
Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before the LORD; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

determinate.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:

determination.en: Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the LORD, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

determine.en: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

determined.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.
For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.

detest.en: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

detestable.en: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will recompense their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.

device.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
Lest Satan should get an advantage of us: for we are not ignorant of his devices.

devil.en: Neither give place to the devil.
And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

devilish.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

devise.en: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

devote.en: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD.

devoted.en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

devotion.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

devour.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
Open thy doors, O Lebanon, that the fire may devour thy cedars.

devourer.en: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.

devout.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him.
And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.

dew.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

diadem.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the LORD, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.

dial.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the LORD: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.

diamond.en: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

diana.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;

did.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.
And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

didst.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.

die.en: Last of all the woman died also.
And last of all the woman died also.

diet.en: And for his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

differ.en: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

difference.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.

dig.en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

dignity.en: Folly is set in great dignity, and the rich sit in low place.
They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

diligence.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

diligent.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

diligently.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

dim.en: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.
Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

diminish.en: Go ye, get you straw where ye can find it: yet not ought of your work shall be diminished.
Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.

dimness.en: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.

Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.

din.en: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs.

dine.en: And as he spake, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.
Jesus saith unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who art thou? knowing that it was the Lord.

dinner.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner.

dip.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, even before the vail.
And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.

direct.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.

direction.en: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

directly.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
And according to the doors of the chambers that were toward the south was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

dirt.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

disallow.en: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of God, and precious,
And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

disannul.en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
For the LORD of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

disappoint.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
Arise, O LORD, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

disappointed.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

discern.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

discerner.en: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

discerning.en: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:

discharge.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.

My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.

disciple.en: And there they abode long time with the disciples.
Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

discipline.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

disclose.en: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

discomfit.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

discomfiture.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

discontented.en: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

discontinue.en: And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee; and I will cause thee to serve thine enemies in the land which thou knowest not: for ye have kindled a fire in mine anger, which shall burn for ever.

discord.en: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.

discourage.en: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.

discover.en: A man shall not take his father’s wife, nor discover his father’s skirt.
Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.

discreet.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

discretion.en: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.

disdained.en: And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.
But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

disease.en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
And after all this the LORD smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

diseased.en: And a great multitude followed him, because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased.
And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

disfigure.en: Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

disgrace.en: Do not abhor us, for thy name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

disguise.en: So the prophet departed, and waited for the king by the way, and disguised himself with ashes upon his face.
The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

dish.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.
And he answered and said unto them, It is one of the twelve, that dippeth with me in the dish.

dishonest.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey, to shed blood, and to destroy souls, to get dishonest gain.
Behold, therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made, and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee.

dishonesty.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

dishonour.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.

dishonourest.en: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

dishonoureth.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.

disinherit.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

dismay.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

dismiss.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle:

disobedience.en: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

disobedient.en: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

disobey.en: And he cried unto the man of God that came from Judah, saying, Thus saith the LORD, Forasmuch as thou hast disobeyed the mouth of the LORD, and hast not kept the commandment which the LORD thy God commanded thee,

disorderly.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us: for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you;
For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.

dispatch.en: And the company shall stone them with stones, and dispatch them with their swords; they shall slay their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

dispensation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:
Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;

disperse.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.

dispersed.en: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
(As it is written, He hath dispersed abroad; he hath given to the poor: his righteousness remaineth for ever.

dispersion.en: Howl, ye shepherds, and cry; and wallow yourselves in the ashes, ye principal of the flock: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished; and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel.

displayed.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

displease.en: The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.

displeasure.en: O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

dispose.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.

disposed.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

disposition.en: Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it.

dispossess.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

disputation.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

dispute.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

disputer.en: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

disquiet.en: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.

disquietness.en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

dissemble.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

dissembler.en: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

dissension.en: And when he had so said, there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees: and the multitude was divided.

When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question.

dissimulation.en: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

dissolve.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

dissolving.en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and shewing of hard sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar: now let Daniel be called, and he will shew the interpretation.

distaff.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.

distant.en: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

distil.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

distinction.en: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?

distinctly.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

distracted.en: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

distraction.en: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

distress.en: In my distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

distribute.en: That they do good, that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

distributing.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

distribution.en: And laid them down at the apostles’ feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need.
Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

ditch.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.

divers.en: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

diverse.en: And four great beasts came up from the sea, diverse one from another.
And they gave them drink in vessels of gold, (the vessels being diverse one from another,) and royal wine in abundance, according to the state of the king.

divide.en: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.

divided.en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

divider.en: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?

dividing.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

divination.en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith it; albeit I have not spoken?

divine.en: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

diviner.en: Then shall the seers be ashamed, and the diviners confounded: yea, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer of God.
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

divining.en: And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

division.en: So there was a division among the people because of him.
And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

divorce.en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

divorcement.en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.
It hath been said, Whosoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorcement:

do.en: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
And this will we do, if God permit.

doctor.en: And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions.
Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space;

doctrine.en: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

dodo.en: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.

doer.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

dog.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.

doing.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
This is the LORD’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

doleful.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.

In that day shall one take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, and say, We be utterly spoiled: he hath changed the portion of my people: how hath he removed it from me! turning away he hath divided our fields.

dominion.en: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.
To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

done.en: Let all your things be done with charity.
Let all things be done decently and in order.

door.en: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
And all the city was gathered together at the door.

doorkeeper.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

dor.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
The son of Abinadab, in all the region of Dor; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife:

dost.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

dote.en: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

doted.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes, she doted upon them, and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea.
And Aholah played the harlot when she was mine; and she doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbours,

doth.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

doting.en: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

double.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

doubt.en: And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted.
No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

doubtful.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.

doubting.en: Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spake.
Arise therefore, and get thee down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them.

doubtless.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

dough.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.

dove.en: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
Behold, thou art fair, my love; behold, thou art fair; thou hast doves’ eyes.

down.en: And sitting down they watched him there;
Save thyself, and come down from the cross.

downsitting.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

downward.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?

dowry.en: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
Ask me never so much dowry and gift, and I will give according as ye shall say unto me: but give me the damsel to wife.

drag.en: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

dragon.en: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

dram.en: Also twenty basons of gold, of a thousand drams; and two vessels of fine copper, precious as gold.
And some of the chief of the fathers gave to the treasure of the work twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver.

drank.en: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

draught.en: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken:
Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

drave.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

draw.en: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.

drawer.en: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
Now therefore ye are cursed, and there shall none of you be freed from being bondmen, and hewers of wood and drawers of water for the house of my God.

drawing.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the LORD, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the LORD go down to the gates.

drawn.en: And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven.
But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

dread.en: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

dreadful.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

dream.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:

dreamer.en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

dreg.en: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the LORD the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.

For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

dress.en: And the LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.
Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to thy brother Amnon’s house, and dress him meat.

dresser.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbereth it the ground?

Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

drew.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;

drie.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

dried.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.

drink.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
And he made them a feast, and they did eat and drink.

drinker.en: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

drinking.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

drive.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

driven.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

driver.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

driving.en: Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.
And the watchman told, saying, He came even unto them, and cometh not again: and the driving is like the driving of Jehu the son of Nimshi; for he driveth furiously.

dromedary.en: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

drop.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

dropping.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

dropsy.en: And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy.

dross.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.

drought.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

drove.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.
And Caleb drove thence the three sons of Anak, Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

drown.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

drowsiness.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

drunk.en: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new: for he saith, The old is better.

drunkard.en: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

drunken.en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

drunkenness.en: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
Thou shalt be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of thy sister Samaria.

dry.en: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

due.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

duke.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,

dulcimer.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

dull.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.

For the heart of this people is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.

dumb.en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.
As they went out, behold, they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil.

dung.en: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

dungeon.en: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

dunghill.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

dur.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.

dura.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

durable.en: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

durst.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them.

dust.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

duty.en: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
And that doeth not any of those duties, but even hath eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,

dwarf.en: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

dwell.en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
Who is like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

dweller.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,
All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

dwelling.en: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

dwelt.en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

dye.en: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

dying.en: Now there were seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and dying left no seed.
As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;

each.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.

eagle.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

ear.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
If any man have an ear, let him hear.

eared.en: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer’s neck there in the valley:

earing.en: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
For these two years hath the famine been in the land: and yet there are five years, in the which there shall neither be earing nor harvest.

early.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

earn.en: Ye have sown much, and bring in little; ye eat, but ye have not enough; ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink; ye clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

earnest.en: Who hath also sealed us, and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts.
But thanks be to God, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

earnestly.en: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:

earring.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

earth.en: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of the LORD.
For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.

earthen.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

earthly.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

earthquake.en: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.

earthy.en: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

ease.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

easily.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

east.en: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

easter.en: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

eastward.en: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.
And the breadth of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

easy.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.

eat.en: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

eater.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

eating.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, He hath a devil.
For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and ye say, He hath a devil.

ebony.en: The men of Dedan were thy merchants; many isles were the merchandise of thine hand: they brought thee for a present horns of ivory and ebony.

eden.en: Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Chilmad, were thy merchants.
