forced.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

forcible.en: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

forcing.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man’s life) to employ them in the siege:

ford.en: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
And he rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two womenservants, and his eleven sons, and passed over the ford Jabbok.

forecast.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

forefather.en: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;

They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

forefront.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.
The forefront of the one was situate northward over against Michmash, and the other southward over against Gibeah.

forehead.en: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
And I put a jewel on thy forehead, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thine head.

foreigner.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

foreknow.en: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

foreknowledge.en: Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, ye have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain:
Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

foremost.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
And he commanded the foremost, saying, When Esau my brother meeteth thee, and asketh thee, saying, Whose art thou? and whither goest thou? and whose are these before thee?

foreordain.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

forepart.en: And the wall that was without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
And falling into a place where two seas met, they ran the ship aground; and the forepart stuck fast, and remained unmoveable, but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves.

forerunner.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Jesus, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.

foresee.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.

foreship.en: And as the shipmen were about to flee out of the ship, when they had let down the boat into the sea, under colour as though they would have cast anchors out of the foreship,

foreskin.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

forest.en: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

foretell.en: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

forewarn.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
That no man go beyond and defraud his brother in any matter: because that the Lord is the avenger of all such, as we also have forewarned you and testified.

forfeit.en: And that whosoever would not come within three days, according to the counsel of the princes and the elders, all his substance should be forfeited, and himself separated from the congregation of those that had been carried away.

forgave.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

forge.en: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

forger.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

forget.en: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.
Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

forgetful.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

forgetfulness.en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

forgive.en: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

forgiveness.en: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

forgiving.en: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ’s sake hath forgiven you.
Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

forgot.en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.

forgotten.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

fork.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

form.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

formed.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

former.en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

fornication.en: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

fornicator.en: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

forsake.en: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.
For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.

forswear.en: Again, ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time, Thou shalt not forswear thyself, but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths:

fort.en: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

forth.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

forthwith.en: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

fortieth.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;

fortify.en: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

fortress.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
And he said, The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

forty.en: The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.
The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

forum.en: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

forward.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

forwardness.en: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal hath provoked very many.

fought.en: Then came Amalek, and fought with Israel in Rephidim.
And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

foul.en: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
And as for my flock, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.

found.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

foundation.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

founder.en: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

fountain.en: Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.

four.en: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

fourfold.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

fourfooted.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

fourscore.en: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, an hundred fourscore and eight.

foursquare.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.
It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

fourteen.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
These are the sons of Rachel, which were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

fourteenth.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’s passover.

fourth.en: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

fowl.en: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

fowler.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

fox.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Even that which they build, if a fox go up, he shall even break down their stone wall.
And he said unto them, Go ye, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and to morrow, and the third day I shall be perfected.

foxes.en: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

fragment.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.
And they did all eat, and were filled: and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full.

frail.en: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it is: that I may know how frail I am.

frame.en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

frankincense.en: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.

frankly.en: And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most?

fraud.en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

fray.en: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

freckled.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

free.en: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.

freedom.en: And the chief captain answered, With a great sum obtained I this freedom. And Paul said, But I was free born.

And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

freely.en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for it is good.
Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

freeman.en: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is the Lord’s freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Christ’s servant.

freewill.en: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.
Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.

frequent.en: Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

fresh.en: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

fret.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

frett.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

fretted.en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these things; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

fried.en: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;

If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

friend.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

friendly.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

Then she said, Let me find favour in thy sight, my lord; for that thou hast comforted me, and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid, though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens.

friendship.en: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
Ye adulterers and adulteresses, know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God.

fringe.en: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.

Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

fro.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.

frog.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:

from.en: I receive not honour from men.
But God raised him from the dead:

front.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind, he chose of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians:

And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

frontier.en: Therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory of the country, Bethjeshimoth, Baalmeon, and Kiriathaim,

frontlet.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

frost.en: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

froward.en: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.

frozen.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

fruit.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:

fruitful.en: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

frustrate.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

fuel.en: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for any work?

fugitive.en: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds: and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.

fulfill.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

full.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

fuller.en: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.
But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:

fully.en: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

fulness.en: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

furbish.en: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.

furious.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:

furlong.en: Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:
And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.

furnace.en: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.

furnish.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

furniture.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
The candlestick also for the light, and his furniture, and his lamps, with the oil for the light,

furrow.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

further.en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
Then the high priest rent his clothes, and saith, What need we any further witnesses?

furtherance.en: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

furthermore.en: Furthermore, when I came to Troas to preach Christ’s gospel, and a door was opened unto me of the Lord,

fury.en: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;
And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen, such as they have not heard.

gad.en: Dan, and Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

gain.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

gainsay.en: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

gainsayer.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

galatian.en: O foolish Galatians, who hath bewitched you, that ye should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

galbanum.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

gale.en: And Laban called it Jegarsahadutha: but Jacob called it Galeed.
And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;

galilee.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee.

gall.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

gallant.en: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

gallery.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king is held in the galleries.
Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.

galley.en: But there the glorious LORD will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.

gallows.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

gap.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.

garden.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.

gardener.en: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

garland.en: Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

garment.en: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

garner.en: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

garnish.en: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

garrison.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Bethlehem.

gat.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

gate.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.

gather.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

gatherer.en: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

gathering.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
Now we beseech you, brethren, by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and by our gathering together unto him,

gave.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac.

gay.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit thou here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand thou there, or sit here under my footstool:

gaze.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.
Which also said, Ye men of Galilee, why stand ye gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go into heaven.

gazer.en: And David did so, as the LORD had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gazer.
David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

gazingstock.en: And I will cast abominable filth upon thee, and make thee vile, and will set thee as a gazingstock.
Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.

gender.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

genealogy.en: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.

general.en: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.
To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

generally.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the LORD.
Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that thou go to battle in thine own person.

generation.en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

gentil.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

gentile.en: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

gentle.en: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

gentleness.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

gently.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.

And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

gerah.en: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

get.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

getting.en: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.

ghost.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Ghost.

giant.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

gift.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

gin.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

gird.en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

girding.en: And in that day did the Lord GOD of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:

And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.

girdle.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.

girl.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

girt.en: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

give.en: Neither give place to the devil.
Give us this day our daily bread.

given.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.

giver.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

giving.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.

glad.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

gladly.en: For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.
And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

gladness.en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

glass.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

glean.en: So she gleaned in the field until even, and beat out that she had gleaned: and it was about an ephah of barley.
And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her, and leave them, that she may glean them, and rebuke her not.

gleaning.en: If grapegatherers come to thee, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
And he said unto them, What have I done now in comparison of you? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?

glede.en: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

glister.en: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.

Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

glitter.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

gloominess.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

glorify.en: And they glorified God in me.
And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

glorious.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

glory.en: For ye are our glory and joy.
To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

glutton.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
And they shall say unto the elders of his city, This our son is stubborn and rebellious, he will not obey our voice; he is a glutton, and a drunkard.

gluttonous.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!
The Son of man came eating and drinking, and they say, Behold a man gluttonous, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners. But wisdom is justified of her children.

gnash.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

gnat.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

gnaw.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

go.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

goa.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.

goad.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.
The words of the wise are as goads, and as nails fastened by the masters of assemblies, which are given from one shepherd.

goat.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

goatskin.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

gob.en: And it came to pass after this, that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob: then Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Saph, which was of the sons of the giant.

And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines, where Elhanan the son of Jaareoregim, a Bethlehemite, slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

goblet.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.

god.en: And they glorified God in me.
And God spake unto Noah, saying,

goddess.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.

godhead.en: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.

godliness.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

godly.en: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

gog.en: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal:

going.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

gold.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
And he overlaid the cherubims with gold.

golden.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

goldsmith.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants.
The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.

golgotha.en: And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull,
And they bring him unto the place Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

gomer.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

gone.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

good.en: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
For by it the elders obtained a good report.

goodliness.en: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:

goodly.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

goodman.en: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
And when they had received it, they murmured against the goodman of the house,

goodness.en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
(For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

goods.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, his goods are in peace:
Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

gopher.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.

gore.en: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

gorgeous.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate.

gospel.en: And there they preached the gospel.
And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

got.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

gotten.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

gourd.en: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd that it withered.
And God said to Jonah, Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd? And he said, I do well to be angry, even unto death.

govern.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

government.en: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

governor.en: (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.)
Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.

grace.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.
But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.

gracious.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

graciously.en: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.
Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

graff.en: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

grain.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

grandmother.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.

grant.en: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

grape.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.
Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

grass.en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

grasshopper.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
They shall cut down her forest, saith the LORD, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.

grate.en: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.
The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

grave.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

graveclothes.en: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

gravel.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

graven.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?

graves.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose,

graving.en: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be thy gods, O Israel, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

gravity.en: One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity;
In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

gray.en: And if ye take this also from me, and mischief befall him, ye shall bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.

grease.en: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

great.en: And there was great joy in that city.
This is the first and great commandment.

greatly.en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:

greatness.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

greaves.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

grecian.en: And he spake boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him.
And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spake unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus.

greece.en: And when he had gone over those parts, and had given them much exhortation, he came into Greece,
When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.

greedily.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

greediness.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

greedy.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

greek.en: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:

green.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
Behold, thou art fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed is green.

greenish.en: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

greenness.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

greet.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

greeting.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
Claudius Lysias unto the most excellent governor Felix sendeth greeting.

grew.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.

grey.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.

greyhound.en: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.

grief.en: Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah.
A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

grievance.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

grieve.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

grieving.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

grievous.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
And the thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight because of his son.

grind.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

grinder.en: In the day when the keepers of the house shall tremble, and the strong men shall bow themselves, and the grinders cease because they are few, and those that look out of the windows be darkened,

grinding.en: Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

grisled.en: And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.
The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them; and the grisled go forth toward the south country.

groan.en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

grope.en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

gross.en: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the LORD shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

ground.en: And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.
And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

grove.en: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

grow.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
Howbeit the hair of his head began to grow again after he was shaven.

grown.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

growth.en: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.

grudge.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

grudgingly.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for God loveth a cheerful giver.

guard.en: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
And Nebuzaradan captain of the guard took these, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah:

guest.en: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid, and rose up, and went every man his way.

guide.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

guile.en: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

guilt.en: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.
So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.

guiltiness.en: And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

guiltless.en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

guilty.en: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.

gulf.en: And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence.

gush.en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

gutter.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

ha.en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

habergeon.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

habitable.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

habitation.en: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

had.en: Ahinadab the son of Iddo had Mahanaim:
Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

haft.en: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.

hail.en: And began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!
He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

hailstone.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered morter, that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend it.
Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in my fury to consume it.

hair.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

hairy.en: And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.
And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:

hale.en: As for Saul, he made havock of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison.

When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.

half.en: And after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,
Then Joshua called the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh,

hall.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.
And went again into the judgment hall, and saith unto Jesus, Whence art thou? But Jesus gave him no answer.

hallow.en: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

halt.en: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

ham.en: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

hammer.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?

han.en: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.

hand.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

handbreadth.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about.
Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

handed.en: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

handful.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.

handkerchief.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.

handle.en: And his brother’s name was Jubal: he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ.

handling.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

And I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords:

handmaid.en: And the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s handmaid; Dan, and Naphtali:
And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid.

handmaiden.en: Then the handmaidens came near, they and their children, and they bowed themselves.
And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; and they shall prophesy:

handwriting.en: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

handywork.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.

hang.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

hanging.en: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

hap.en: And she went, and came, and gleaned in the field after the reapers: and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz, who was of the kindred of Elimelech.

haply.en: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.
Lest haply, after he hath laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him,

happen.en: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.
There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

happy.en: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.
Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

hard.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

harden.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

hardened.en: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart, and he would not let them go.
For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

harder.en: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead: fear them not, neither be dismayed at their looks, though they be a rebellious house.

hardly.en: And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.
Then said Jesus unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, That a rich man shall hardly enter into the kingdom of heaven.

hardness.en: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

hare.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get thee into the land of Judah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

harlot.en: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD:
And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

harm.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire, and felt no harm.
Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

harmless.en: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.
For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

harness.en: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
And the king of Israel answered and said, Tell him, Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off.

harp.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

harper.en: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

harping.en: And I heard a voice from heaven, as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of a great thunder: and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps:

harrow.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

hart.en: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.

harvest.en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

harvestman.en: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
Speak, Thus saith the LORD, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.

hast.en: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

haste.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

hasten.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?

hastily.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
Therefore the LORD left those nations, without driving them out hastily; neither delivered he them into the hand of Joshua.

hasty.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.
Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.

hat.en: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

hatch.en: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.

hate.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

hateful.en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

hater.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

hath.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Hath not my hand made all these things?

hatred.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

haughtily.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, from which ye shall not remove your necks; neither shall ye go haughtily: for this time is evil.

haughtiness.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.
We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.

haughty.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

haunt.en: And to them which were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men were wont to haunt.
Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who hath seen him there: for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly.

have.en: Behold, I have told you before.
But ye have not so learned Christ;

haven.en: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.
And, hardly passing it, came unto a place which is called The fair havens; nigh whereunto was the city of Lasea.

having.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
And having an high priest over the house of God;

hawk.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

hay.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.

hazard.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

hazel.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

he.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.

head.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

headband.en: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

headlong.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out.

headstone.en: Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.

heady.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;

heal.en: And Jesus saith unto him, I will come and heal him.
And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

healer.en: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.

healing.en: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was shewed.

health.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

heap.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps: and the land stank.
I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

hear.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
If any man have an ear, let him hear.

heard.en: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:

hearer.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
(For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

hearing.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

hearken.en: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:
If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.

heart.en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

hearted.en: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that the LORD hath commanded;
And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands, and brought that which they had spun, both of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, and of fine linen.

hearth.en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
Now the king sat in the winterhouse in the ninth month: and there was a fire on the hearth burning before him.

heartily.en: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

hearty.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

heat.en: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
Again, if two lie together, then they have heat: but how can one be warm alone?

heath.en: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good cometh; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

heathen.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?
But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

heave.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD.

heaven.en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

heavenly.en: Whereupon, O king Agrippa, I was not disobedient unto the heavenly vision:
For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:

heavily.en: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.
I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

heaviness.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

heavy.en: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

hebrew.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

hebrewess.en: That every man should let his manservant, and every man his maidservant, being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess, go free; that none should serve himself of them, to wit, of a Jew his brother.

hedge.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

heed.en: But take ye heed: behold, I have foretold you all things.
Take ye heed, watch and pray: for ye know not when the time is.

heel.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:

heifer.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction cometh; it cometh out of the north.
For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

height.en: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.

heinous.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

heir.en: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

held.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.

hele.en: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

hell.en: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

helm.en: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

helmet.en: Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet:
And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

help.en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

helper.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

helve.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

hem.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, upon the hem of the robe round about.
And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

hemlock.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
Shall horses run upon the rock? will one plow there with oxen? for ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock:

hen.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
