O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which killest the prophets, and stonest them that are sent unto thee; how often would I have gathered thy children together, as a hen doth gather her brood under her wings, and ye would not!

hence.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
And he said unto him, If thy presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

henceforth.en: Let Israel hope in the LORD from henceforth and for ever.
From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

henceforward.en: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;

And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

her.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

herald.en: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,

herb.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

herd.en: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.

herdman.en: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:

here.en: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.
For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

hereafter.en: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.
Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God.

hereby.en: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

herein.en: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.

hereof.en: And the fame hereof went abroad into all that land.
And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

heresy.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

heretofore.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick, as heretofore: let them go and gather straw for themselves.
And the Philistines were afraid, for they said, God is come into the camp. And they said, Woe unto us! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore.

hereunto.en: For who can eat, or who else can hasten hereunto, more than I?
For even hereunto were ye called: because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that ye should follow his steps:

herewith.en: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith.

Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

heritage.en: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

herma.en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

hermes.en: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

herodian.en: And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to catch him in his words.
And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

heron.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

hers.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
And Abigail hasted, and arose, and rode upon an ass, with five damsels of hers that went after her; and she went after the messengers of David, and became his wife.

herself.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.

hew.en: And above were costly stones, after the measures of hewed stones, and cedars.
And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

hewer.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:

hewn.en: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

hid.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

hidden.en: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his hidden things sought up!
Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

hide.en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

hiding.en: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.
If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

high.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.

highly.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
And to esteem them very highly in love for their work’s sake. And be at peace among yourselves.

highness.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.

highway.en: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
Go ye therefore into the highways, and as many as ye shall find, bid to the marriage.

hill.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

him.en: But Solomon built him an house.
And many believed on him there.

himself.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed.

hin.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
Thou shalt drink also water by measure, the sixth part of an hin: from time to time shalt thou drink.

hind.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet: and setteth me upon my high places.

hinder.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

hindermost.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost, and Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph hindermost.
Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

hindmost.en: How he met thee by the way, and smote the hindmost of thee, even all that were feeble behind thee, when thou wast faint and weary; and he feared not God.
All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

hinge.en: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.

And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

hip.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter: and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam.

hir.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
And am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.

hire.en: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.

hireling.en: The hireling fleeth, because he is an hireling, and careth not for the sheep.
Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

hires.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.

his.en: Amon his son, Josiah his son.

hiss.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
The merchants among the people shall hiss at thee; thou shalt be a terror, and never shalt be any more.

hissing.en: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

hit.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him; and he was sore wounded of the archers.

hither.en: He said, Bring them hither to me.
Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

hitherto.en: But Jesus answered them, My Father worketh hitherto, and I work.
O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

hittite.en: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

ho.en: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the LORD: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

hoar.en: Do therefore according to thy wisdom, and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace.
And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.

hoarfrost.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

hoary.en: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

hod.en: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

hoise.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

hol.en: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
And Jesus saith unto him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.

hold.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

holding.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

hole.en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole of the door, and my bowels were moved for him.
And he brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.

holily.en: Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

holiness.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto holiness.
Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

hollow.en: Hollow with boards shalt thou make it: as it was shewed thee in the mount, so shall they make it.
And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

holpen.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy;
Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

holy.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
His foundation is in the holy mountains.

holyday.en: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

home.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

homeborn.en: Is Israel a servant? is he a homeborn slave? why is he spoiled?
One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.

homer.en: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

honest.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

honestly.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without, and that ye may have lack of nothing.

honesty.en: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

honey.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

honeycomb.en: And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb.
Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

honor.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

honour.en: I receive not honour from men.
Honour widows that are widows indeed.

honourable.en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

honoured.en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.

honourest.en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering, which I have commanded in my habitation; and honourest thy sons above me, to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people?

honoureth.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

honours.en: Who also honoured us with many honours; and when we departed, they laded us with such things as were necessary.

hood.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

hoof.en: This also shall please the LORD better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

hook.en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

hop.en: LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.
These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

hope.en: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

horn.en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

hornet.en: And I will send hornets before thee, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before thee.
Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

horrible.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.

horribly.en: Be astonished, O ye heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid, be ye very desolate, saith the LORD.

Yea, I will make many people amazed at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish my sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.

horror.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

horse.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.

horseback.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
Then he sent out a second on horseback, which came to them, and said, Thus saith the king, Is it peace? And Jehu answered, What hast thou to do with peace? turn thee behind me.

horseman.en: And there stood a watchman on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Jehu as he came, and said, I see a company. And Joram said, Take an horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?

The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

hosanna.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.
And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

hosen.en: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

hospitality.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

host.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts; Consider your ways.
How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

hostage.en: And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of the LORD, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and hostages, and returned to Samaria.
And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obededom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

hot.en: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

hotly.en: And Jacob was wroth, and chode with Laban: and Jacob answered and said to Laban, What is my trespass? what is my sin, that thou hast so hotly pursued after me?

hough.en: And Joshua did unto them as the LORD bade him: he houghed their horses, and burnt their chariots with fire.
And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

hour.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

hours.en: And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in.
But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

house.en: But Solomon built him an house.
And every man went unto his own house.

household.en: And a man’s foes shall be they of his own household.
Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

householder.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
For the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which went out early in the morning to hire labourers into his vineyard.

how.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

howbeit.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

howl.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

howsoever.en: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

huge.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.

humble.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

humbleness.en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

humbly.en: He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the LORD require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God?
Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, thine are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech thee that I may find grace in thy sight, my lord, O king.

humiliation.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.

humility.en: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

hundred.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

hundredfold.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year an hundredfold: and the LORD blessed him.
But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.

hundredth.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.

Restore, I pray you, to them, even this day, their lands, their vineyards, their oliveyards, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, that ye exact of them.

hunger.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.

hungered.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city, he hungered.
Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered.

hungred.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.
For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:

hungry.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

hunt.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

hunter.en: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
He was a mighty hunter before the LORD: wherefore it is said, Even as Nimrod the mighty hunter before the LORD.

hunting.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

hurl.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

hurling.en: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.

hurt.en: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

hurtful.en: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.
But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

husband.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

husbandman.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

husbandry.en: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.

Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

husk.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him.
All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

hymn.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

hypocrisy.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;
Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

hypocrite.en: Ye hypocrites, well did Esaias prophesy of you, saying,
That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

hypocritical.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

hyssop.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

i.en: I am that bread of life.
I and my Father are one.

ice.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

idle.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

idleness.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
By much slothfulness the building decayeth; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through.

idol.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

idolater.en: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

idolatrous.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

idolatry.en: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

if.en: And this will we do, if God permit.
If ye love me, keep my commandments.

ignominy.en: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

ignorance.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

ignorant.en: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before thee.

ignorantly.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.
And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

ill.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

illuminate.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;

image.en: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?

imagery.en: Then said he unto me, Son of man, hast thou seen what the ancients of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? for they say, The LORD seeth us not; the LORD hath forsaken the earth.

imagination.en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.
Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, and all their imaginations against me;

imagine.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

immanuel.en: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

immediately.en: Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew.
And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

immortal.en: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

immortality.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

immutability.en: Wherein God, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

immutable.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for God to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

impart.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

impediment.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

impenitent.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

imperious.en: How weak is thine heart, saith the LORD GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;

implacable.en: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

implead.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

importunity.en: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

impose.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

impossible.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

impotent.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;
In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.

impoverish.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.

imprison.en: And I said, Lord, they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee:

imprisonment.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

impudent.en: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
For they are impudent children and stiffhearted. I do send thee unto them; and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD.

impute.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

in.en: And they glorified God in me.

inasmuch.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

incense.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

incensed.en: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
Surely, shall one say, in the LORD have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.

incline.en: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

inclined.en: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

inclose.en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

incontinency.en: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

incontinent.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

incorruptible.en: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.

incorruption.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

increase.en: He must increase, but I must decrease.
And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith.

incredible.en: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

incurable.en: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
For thus saith the LORD, Thy bruise is incurable, and thy wound is grievous.

indebted.en: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.

indeed.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
For my flesh is meat indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

india.en: Now it came to pass in the days of Ahasuerus, (this is Ahasuerus which reigned, from India even unto Ethiopia, over an hundred and seven and twenty provinces:)

Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

indignation.en: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

indite.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

industrious.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

inexcusable.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

infallible.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:

infamous.en: Those that be near, and those that be far from thee, shall mock thee, which art infamous and much vexed.

infamy.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.

Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

infant.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

inferior.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

infidel.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

infinite.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

infirmity.en: And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.
If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

inflame.en: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!

inflammation.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.

inflict.en: Sufficient to such a man is this punishment, which was inflicted of many.

influence.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

infold.en: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

inform.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

informed.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul, and besought him,
And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding.

ingathering.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of thy labours, which thou hast sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when thou hast gathered in thy labours out of the field.

inhabit.en: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.
The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

inhabitant.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

inhabited.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.

inhabiter.en: Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea! for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.

And I beheld, and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe, woe, woe, to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels, which are yet to sound!

inherit.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

inheritance.en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
So Joshua let the people depart, every man unto his inheritance.

inheritor.en: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

iniquity.en: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

injure.en: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

injurious.en: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

injustice.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

ink.en: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:
Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

inkhorn.en: And, behold, the man clothed with linen, which had the inkhorn by his side, reported the matter, saying, I have done as thou hast commanded me.

And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon he was, to the threshold of the house. And he called to the man clothed with linen, which had the writer’s inkhorn by his side;

inn.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn, that the LORD met him, and sought to kill him.
And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack’s mouth.

inner.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
And he built the inner court with three rows of hewed stone, and a row of cedar beams.

innermost.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

innocency.en: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:

innocent.en: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

innumerable.en: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

inordinate.en: And when her sister Aholibah saw this, she was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she, and in her whoredoms more than her sister in her whoredoms.
Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

inquisition.en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;

inscription.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.

inside.en: And he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar, both the floor of the house, and the walls of the ceiling: and he covered them on the inside with wood, and covered the floor of the house with planks of fir.

insomuch.en: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

inspiration.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

instant.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

instantly.en: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this:
Unto which promise our twelve tribes, instantly serving God day and night, hope to come. For which hope’s sake, king Agrippa, I am accused of the Jews.

instead.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery, which taketh strangers instead of her husband!
Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

instruct.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

instructer.en: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

instruction.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

instructor.en: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ, yet have ye not many fathers: for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel.

instrument.en: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
And the LORD said unto me, Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.

insurrection.en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat,

integrity.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.

intelligence.en: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

intend.en: And said unto them, Ye men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men.
For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

intended.en: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

intent.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him.
Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

intercession.en: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.

intercessor.en: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

intermeddle.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

intermission.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

interpret.en: But he hanged the chief baker: as Joseph had interpreted to them.
Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

interpretation.en: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

interpreter.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them; for he spake unto them by an interpreter.
If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

into.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
And when ye come into an house, salute it.

intreat.en: And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.
And Moses went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

intrude.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

invade.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul, saying, Haste thee, and come; for the Philistines have invaded the land.
And Elisha died, and they buried him. And the bands of the Moabites invaded the land at the coming in of the year.

invasion.en: We made an invasion upon the south of the Cherethites, and upon the coast which belongeth to Judah, and upon the south of Caleb; and we burned Ziklag with fire.

invent.en: That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

invention.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

inventor.en: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

invisible.en: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

invite.en: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baalhazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

inward.en: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

inwardly.en: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.
They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

inwards.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

iron.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

is.en: For our God is a consuming fire.

ishmaelite.en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

island.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island.
And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

isle.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

israelite.en: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

israelitish.en: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the Lord, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

issue.en: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,
Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

it.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
And he took it, and did eat before them.

italian.en: There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band,

itch.en: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

its.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

itself.en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

ivory.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

jacinth.en: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

And thus I saw the horses in the vision, and them that sat on them, having breastplates of fire, and of jacinth, and brimstone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone.

jacob.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.
And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.

jah.en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.

jam.en: And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.
After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

jangling.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

jar.en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

jasper.en: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

javelin.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
And Saul cast the javelin; for he said, I will smite David even to the wall with it. And David avoided out of his presence twice.

jaw.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?

jawbone.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass, and put forth his hand, and took it, and slew a thousand men therewith.
And Samson said, With the jawbone of an ass, heaps upon heaps, with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men.

jealous.en: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

jealousy.en: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

jehovah.en: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
That men may know that thou, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, art the most high over all the earth.

jehu.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,

jeopard.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field.

jeopardy.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.

jerusalem.en: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

jesse.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
And Obed begat Jesse, and Jesse begat David.

jesting.en: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

jesuit.en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

jesus.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?

jew.en: Then said the Jews, Behold how he loved him!
Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.

jewel.en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains of gold.

jewess.en: And after certain days, when Felix came with his wife Drusilla, which was a Jewess, he sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.
Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek:

jewish.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

jewry.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee: for he would not walk in Jewry, because the Jews sought to kill him.
And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirreth up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place.

jezebel.en: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
And of Jezebel also spake the LORD, saying, The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.

jo.en: And these are the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jesaiah.

john.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

join.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

joint.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

jonah.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was very angry.
Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly,

joram.en: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
And Asa begat Josaphat; and Josaphat begat Joram; and Joram begat Ozias;

jordan.en: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
And were baptized of him in Jordan, confessing their sins.

joseph.en: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

jot.en: For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

journey.en: And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.
And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

joy.en: For ye are our glory and joy.
And there was great joy in that city.

joyful.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

joyous.en: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:

judas.en: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.
And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

judge.en: Judge not, that ye be not judged.
Ye judge after the flesh; I judge no man.

judgment.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged.

juice.en: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.

jumping.en: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

juniper.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

jupiter.en: And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker.
Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people.

jurisdiction.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time.

just.en: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.

justice.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

justification.en: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

justifier.en: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

justify.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

justle.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

justly.en: And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man hath done nothing amiss.
Ye are witnesses, and God also, how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe:

keep.en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
If ye love me, keep my commandments.

keeper.en: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.
The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

keeping.en: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
They were a wall unto us both by night and day, all the while we were with them keeping the sheep.

kept.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.

kerchief.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.

And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you?

kernel.en: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

kettle.en: And he struck it into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot; all that the fleshhook brought up the priest took for himself. So they did in Shiloh unto all the Israelites that came thither.

key.en: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

kick.en: And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.
But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

kid.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

kidney.en: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

killing.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.
By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.

kiln.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brick-kiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

kin.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

kind.en: And every raven after his kind,

kindle.en: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.
His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.

kindly.en: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
And spake kindly unto him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings that were with him in Babylon,

kindness.en: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

kindred.en: And they said unto her, There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name.
Give unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.

kine.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
The seven good kine are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years: the dream is one.

king.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.

kingdom.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.
And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.

kingly.en: But when his heart was lifted up, and his mind hardened in pride, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

kinsfolk.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day’s journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance.

kinsman.en: Therefore the kinsman said unto Boaz, Buy it for thee. So he drew off his shoe.
And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman: howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I.

kinswoman.en: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.

kish.en: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

kiss.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss.

kite.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

knead.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
And the woman had a fat calf in the house; and she hasted, and killed it, and took flour, and kneaded it, and did bake unleavened bread thereof:

knee.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak as water.

kneel.en: And when he had thus spoken, he kneeled down, and prayed with them all.
O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.

knew.en: Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.
For he knew that for envy they had delivered him.

knife.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
And Abraham stretched forth his hand, and took the knife to slay his son.

knit.en: So all the men of Israel were gathered against the city, knit together as one man.
And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:

knives.en: And Joshua made him sharp knives, and circumcised the children of Israel at the hill of the foreskins.
And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

knock.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you:

knocking.en: But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished.

knop.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds, his knops, and his flowers:
Their knops and their branches were of the same: all of it was one beaten work of pure gold.

know.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

knowing.en: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.

knowledge.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.

known.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
And the way of peace have they not known:

labour.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

laboured.en: And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.
For what hath man of all his labour, and of the vexation of his heart, wherein he hath laboured under the sun?

labourer.en: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house.

labourers.en: For we are labourers together with God: ye are God’s husbandry, ye are God’s building.
Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few;

laboureth.en: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.

labouring.en: The sleep of a labouring man is sweet, whether he eat little or much: but the abundance of the rich will not suffer him to sleep.
For ye remember, brethren, our labour and travail: for labouring night and day, because we would not be chargeable unto any of you, we preached unto you the gospel of God.

labours.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;

lace.en: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.
And thou shalt put it on a blue lace, that it may be upon the mitre; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be.

lack.en: Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.
The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

lad.en: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

ladder.en: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.

lade.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;
And he said, Woe unto you also, ye lawyers! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

laden.en: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

lading.en: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and lading asses; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all manner of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals.

lady.en: Her wise ladies answered her, yea, she returned answer to herself,
Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.

laid.en: And they laid their hands on him, and took him.
And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

lain.en: Then when Jesus came, he found that he had lain in the grave four days already.
For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

lake.en: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

lama.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?

lamb.en: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

lame.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple; and he healed them.

lament.en: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

lamentable.en: And when he came to the den, he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel: and the king spake and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is thy God, whom thou servest continually, able to deliver thee from the lions?

lamentation.en: Now, thou son of man, take up a lamentation for Tyrus;
Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,

lamented.en: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dieth?
And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son:

lamp.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

lance.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.

lancet.en: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

land.en: And the famine was sore in the land.
Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

landed.en: And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch.
Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

landing.en: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

landmark.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

lane.en: So that servant came, and shewed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in hither the poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind.

language.en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

languish.en: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

languishing.en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

lantern.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.

laodicean.en: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things saith the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God;

lap.en: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

lapp.en: And the number of them that lapped, putting their hand to their mouth, were three hundred men: but all the rest of the people bowed down upon their knees to drink water.
And the LORD said unto Gideon, By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you, and deliver the Midianites into thine hand: and let all the other people go every man unto his place.
