lapwing.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

large.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand.
And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

largeness.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.

last.en: Last of all the woman died also.
And last of all the woman died also.

lasting.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

latchet.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

late.en: His disciples say unto him, Master, the Jews of late sought to stone thee; and goest thou thither again?
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

lately.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them.

latin.en: And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

latter.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

lattice.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
The mother of Sisera looked out at a window, and cried through the lattice, Why is his chariot so long in coming? why tarry the wheels of his chariots?

laud.en: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

laugh.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

laughing.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

laughter.en: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

launch.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.

laver.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

lavish.en: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.

law.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

lawful.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,

lawgiver.en: For the LORD is our judge, the LORD is our lawgiver, the LORD is our king; he will save us.
There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who art thou that judgest another?

lawless.en: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

lawyer.en: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying thou reproachest us also.

lay.en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

laying.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him.

lead.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

leader.en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.

leaf.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

league.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites, Peradventure ye dwell among us; and how shall we make a league with you?

lean.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.

leaning.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus’ bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.
By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

leanness.en: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

leap.en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

leaping.en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.

learn.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.

learned.en: But ye have not so learned Christ;
But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

learning.en: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

leasing.en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

least.en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God.

leather.en: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

leathern.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel’s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his meat was locusts and wild honey.

leave.en: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.
And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

leaved.en: Thus saith the LORD to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;

leaven.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

leaves.en: And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.
Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When her branch is yet tender, and putteth forth leaves, ye know that summer is near:

led.en: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.
And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate.

ledge.en: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

leek.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

lees.en: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, The LORD will not do good, neither will he do evil.

left.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

leg.en: His legs of iron, his feet part of iron and part of clay.
The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

legion.en: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.
And Jesus asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.

leisure.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

lend.en: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

lender.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.

And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

length.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.

lengthen.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as thy father David did walk, then I will lengthen thy days.
Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;

lent.en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD. And he worshipped the LORD there.

lentil.en: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
Then Jacob gave Esau bread and pottage of lentiles; and he did eat and drink, and rose up, and went his way: thus Esau despised his birthright.

leopard.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

leper.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

leprosy.en: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

leprous.en: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

less.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
And the children of Israel did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

lesser.en: And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.

lest.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping.

let.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.

lette.en: Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace, according to thy word:
That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

letter.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

leviathan.en: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.
Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?

levite.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
And of the Levites were divisions in Judah, and in Benjamin.

levitical.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

levy.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
And he sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.

lewd.en: Yet they went in unto her, as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot: so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah, the lewd women.

Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

li.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

liar.en: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

liberal.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.

liberality.en: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

liberally.en: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

libertine.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.

liberty.en: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.
So speak ye, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

libyan.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.

lice.en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice, but they could not: so there were lice upon man, and upon beast.

licence.en: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,

To whom I answered, It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die, before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face, and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him.

lick.en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man’s table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores.

lid.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.

lie.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.

lied.en: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?

lien.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
And Abimelech said, What is this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

lier.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.

lieutenant.en: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
And they delivered the king’s commissions unto the king’s lieutenants, and to the governors on this side the river: and they furthered the people, and the house of God.

life.en: I am that bread of life.
So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

lifetime.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
But Abraham said, Son, remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and thou art tormented.

lift.en: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the LORD.

lifter.en: But thou, O LORD, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.

lifting.en: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.

light.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

lighten.en: For thou art my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness.
A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of thy people Israel.

lighter.en: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.
And he said unto them, What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which thy father did put upon us lighter?

lighting.en: And Jesus, when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

lightly.en: I beheld the mountains, and, lo, they trembled, and all the hills moved lightly.
But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

lightness.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
When I therefore was thus minded, did I use lightness? or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be yea yea, and nay nay?

lightning.en: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow:
His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

lights.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;

ligure.en: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

like.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.

liken.en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.

likeness.en: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

likewise.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
Likewise the second also, and the third, unto the seventh.

liking.en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

And the prince of the eunuchs said unto Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who hath appointed your meat and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse liking than the children which are of your sort? then shall ye make me endanger my head to the king.

lily.en: I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.
As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.

lime.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
Thus saith the LORD; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

limit.en: This is the law of the house; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

limited.en: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and limited the Holy One of Israel.

lin.en: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

line.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
I lifted up mine eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

lineage.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:)

linen.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.

linger.en: For except we had lingered, surely now we had returned this second time.
And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

lintel.en: And for the entering of the oracle he made doors of olive tree: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall.

For the LORD will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the LORD will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.

lion.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.

lioness.en: And say, What is thy mother? A lioness: she lay down among lions, she nourished her whelps among young lions.
The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

lionlike.en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.

And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man, of Kabzeel, who had done many acts, he slew two lionlike men of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow:

lip.en: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

liquor.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.

list.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.
But I say unto you, That Elias is come already, and they knew him not, but have done unto him whatsoever they listed. Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them.

listen.en: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The LORD hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.

litter.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the LORD out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the LORD, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the LORD.

little.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

live.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
For now we live, if ye stand fast in the Lord.

lived.en: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:

lively.en: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
Ye also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

liver.en: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

lives.en: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

living.en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

lizard.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

lo.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

load.en: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

loaf.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.
And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:

loan.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife, and said, The LORD give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the LORD. And they went unto their own home.

loath.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.

And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

loathe.en: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

loathsome.en: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

loaves.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.
And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

lock.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
His head is as the most fine gold, his locks are bushy, and black as a raven.

locust.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;

lodge.en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

lodged.en: And he left them, and went out of the city into Bethany; and he lodged there.
And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

lodging.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

loft.en: And he said unto her, Give me thy son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus, being fallen into a deep sleep: and as Paul was long preaching, he sunk down with sleep, and fell down from the third loft, and was taken up dead.

loftily.en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

loftiness.en: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the LORD alone shall be exalted in that day.

lofty.en: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

log.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD:

loin.en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.

long.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
And there they abode long time with the disciples.

longer.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not;

longing.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

look.en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.

looking.en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

loop.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling, and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

loos.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

loose.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he giveth goodly words.
Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

lop.en: Behold, the Lord, the LORD of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.

lord.en: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

lordly.en: He asked water, and she gave him milk; she brought forth butter in a lordly dish.

lordship.en: And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors.
But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

los.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it: and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it.

lose.en: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

loss.en: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

lost.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
For the Son of man is come to save that which was lost.

lot.en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD:

loth.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month; and my soul lothed them, and their soul also abhorred me.
None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

loud.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
(She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

love.en: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

lovely.en: His mouth is most sweet: yea, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
Saul and Jonathan were lovely and pleasant in their lives, and in their death they were not divided: they were swifter than eagles, they were stronger than lions.

lover.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

loving.en: A GOOD name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.

low.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.

lower.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.

lowing.en: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

And the kine took the straight way to the way of Bethshemesh, and went along the highway, lowing as they went, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Bethshemesh.

lowliness.en: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

lowly.en: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

lucifer.en: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

lucre.en: Not given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre; but patient, not a brawler, not covetous;
Likewise must the deacons be grave, not doubletongued, not given to much wine, not greedy of filthy lucre;

luke.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

lukewarm.en: So then because thou art lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spue thee out of my mouth.

lump.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

lurk.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

lust.en: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

lusty.en: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.

luz.en: And goeth out from Bethel to Luz, and passeth along unto the borders of Archi to Ataroth,
And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)

lydian.en: Come up, ye horses; and rage, ye chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.

lying.en: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.
Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

maa.en: Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda,

macedonian.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

mad.en: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?

made.en: Hath not my hand made all these things?
And they did so, and made them all sit down.

madness.en: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.

magdala.en: And he sent away the multitude, and took ship, and came into the coasts of Magdala.

magician.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments, and brought up frogs upon the land of Egypt.
And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told this unto the magicians; but there was none that could declare it to me.

magistrate.en: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city,

magnifical.en: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the LORD must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

magnificence.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.

magnify.en: And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,
Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

maha.en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

Then the Levites arose, Mahath the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azariah, of the sons of the Kohathites: and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azariah the son of Jehalelel: and of the Gershonites; Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah:

maid.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.
And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.

maiden.en: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

maidservant.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

mail.en: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.
And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

maim.en: But when thou makest a feast, call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind:
And great multitudes came unto him, having with them those that were lame, blind, dumb, maimed, and many others, and cast them down at Jesus’ feet; and he healed them:

mainsail.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

maintain.en: The LORD is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.
Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.

maintenance.en: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
Now because we have maintenance from the king’s palace, and it was not meet for us to see the king’s dishonour, therefore have we sent and certified the king;

majesty.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

make.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
Until I make thy foes thy footstool.

maker.en: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

making.en: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,

male.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

malefactor.en: And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death.
They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

malice.en: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.

malicious.en: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he doeth, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither doth he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casteth them out of the church.

malignity.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

mallows.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

mammon.en: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?
And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when ye fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations.

man.en: If any man have an ear, let him hear.
And every man went unto his own house.

mandrake.en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits, new and old, which I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.

maneh.en: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels, shall be your maneh.

manger.en: And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a manger.
And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.

manifest.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
And ye know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin.

manifestation.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

manifestly.en: Forasmuch as ye are manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.

manifold.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting.
O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.

mankind.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

manna.en: Your fathers did eat manna in the wilderness, and are dead.
And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

manner.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

manservant.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

mansion.en: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

manslayer.en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

mantle.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

many.en: And many believed on him there.
For many are called, but few are chosen.

mar.en: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

mara.en: And she said unto them, Call me not Naomi, call me Mara: for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me.

maranatha.en: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.

marble.en: His legs are as pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance is as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.

Where were white, green, and blue, hangings, fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble: the beds were of gold and silver, upon a pavement of red, and blue, and white, and black, marble.

march.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

mariner.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.
And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;

marish.en: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

mark.en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

marked.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
And it came to pass, as she continued praying before the LORD, that Eli marked her mouth.

market.en: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
Woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets.

marriage.en: And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage.
The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

married.en: And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come.
In those days also saw I Jews that had married wives of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

marrow.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

marry.en: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

mars.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

mart.en: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.

martyr.en: And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed, I also was standing by, and consenting unto his death, and kept the raiment of them that slew him.
And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

marvel.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.

mary.en: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
And Mary said, My soul doth magnify the Lord,

mash.en: And the children of Aram; Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

mason.en: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

mast.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee.

master.en: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
Ye call me Master and Lord: and ye say well; for so I am.

mastery.en: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

mate.en: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
Seek ye out of the book of the LORD, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.

matrix.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males shall be the LORD’s.

matter.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
So he consented to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

mattock.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.
Yet they had a file for the mattocks, and for the coulters, and for the forks, and for the axes, and to sharpen the goads.

maul.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.

maw.en: And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

may.en: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

me.en: And they glorified God in me.
He said, Bring them hither to me.

meadow.en: And, behold, there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed; and they fed in a meadow.
And, behold, there came up out of the river seven kine, fatfleshed and well favoured; and they fed in a meadow:

meal.en: It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

mealtime.en: And Boaz said unto her, At mealtime come thou hither, and eat of the bread, and dip thy morsel in the vinegar. And she sat beside the reapers: and he reached her parched corn, and she did eat, and was sufficed, and left.

mean.en: For I mean not that other men be eased, and ye burdened:
In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.

meaning.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
And entering into a ship of Adramyttium, we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

meant.en: And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant.
And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.

measure.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers.
The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

measured.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.

measuring.en: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.

meat.en: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

meddle.en: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.

meddling.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

mede.en: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes,

media.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
In the third year of his reign, he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants; the power of Persia and Media, the nobles and princes of the provinces, being before him:

median.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom, being about threescore and two years old.

mediator.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but God is one.
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;

medicine.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
There is none to plead thy cause, that thou mayest be bound up: thou hast no healing medicines.

meditate.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

meditation.en: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

meek.en: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.
When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

meekness.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

meet.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.

meeting.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee?
Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.

melody.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

melon.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

melt.en: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

melting.en: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!

member.en: For the body is not one member, but many.
But now are they many members, yet but one body.

memorial.en: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
Thy name, O LORD, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

memory.en: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

men.en: I receive not honour from men.
And all the men were about twelve.

mend.en: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
And going on from thence, he saw other two brethren, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in a ship with Zebedee their father, mending their nets; and he called them.

menstruous.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a menstruous woman,

Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.

mention.en: I thank my God, making mention of thee always in my prayers,
Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

merchandise.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his farm, another to his merchandise:

merchant.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.

merciful.en: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.
Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

mercy.en: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

mere.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.

merrily.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

merry.en: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry:

mess.en: And he took and sent messes unto them from before him: but Benjamin’s mess was five times so much as any of theirs. And they drank, and were merry with him.
And David said to Uriah, Go down to thy house, and wash thy feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

message.en: For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.

messenger.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David, she said, He is sick.
And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

messiah.en: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

messias.en: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.

met.en: And Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.

mete.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

meteyard.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

mice.en: And they laid the ark of the LORD upon the cart, and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods.

Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods, and images of your mice that mar the land; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel: peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you, and from off your gods, and from off your land.

midday.en: At midday, O king, I saw in the way a light from heaven, above the brightness of the sun, shining round about me and them which journeyed with me.
And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

middle.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other.

middlemost.en: Now the upper chambers were shorter: for the galleries were higher than these, than the lower, and than the middlemost of the building.
For they were in three stories, but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore the building was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

midnight.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.
And Moses said, Thus saith the LORD, About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt:

midst.en: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

midwife.en: And it came to pass, when she was in hard labour, that the midwife said unto her, Fear not; thou shalt have this son also.
And it came to pass, when she travailed, that the one put out his hand: and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread, saying, This came out first.

midwive.en: And it came to pass, because the midwives feared God, that he made them houses.
Therefore God dealt well with the midwives: and the people multiplied, and waxed very mighty.

might.en: And ye will not come to me, that ye might have life.
And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

mightily.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.

mighty.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

milch.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and ten bulls, twenty she asses, and ten foals.
And the men did so; and took two milch kine, and tied them to the cart, and shut up their calves at home:

mildew.en: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet ye turned not to me, saith the LORD.

I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.

mile.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

milk.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

mill.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

millet.en: Take thou also unto thee wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and fitches, and put them in one vessel, and make thee bread thereof, according to the number of the days that thou shalt lie upon thy side, three hundred and ninety days shalt thou eat thereof.

million.en: And they blessed Rebekah, and said unto her, Thou art our sister, be thou the mother of thousands of millions, and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them.

millstone.en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

mincing.en: Moreover the LORD saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:

mind.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

minded.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

mindful.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?

minding.en: And we went before to ship, and sailed unto Assos, there intending to take in Paul: for so had he appointed, minding himself to go afoot.

mine.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

mingle.en: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

minish.en: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

minister.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

ministration.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?
For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

ministry.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry.

minstrel.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler’s house, and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise,
But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of the LORD came upon him.

mint.en: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

miracle.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

mire.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

mirth.en: I said of laughter, It is mad: and of mirth, What doeth it?
Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

miry.en: But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.
He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

miscarry.en: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

mischief.en: And if any mischief follow, then thou shalt give life for life,
In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

mischievous.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness: and the end of his talk is mischievous madness.

miserable.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

miserably.en: They say unto him, He will miserably destroy those wicked men, and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen, which shall render him the fruits in their seasons.

misery.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

miss.en: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and thou shalt be missed, because thy seat will be empty.
Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth, and not miss.

missing.en: And now I have heard that thou hast shearers: now thy shepherds which were with us, we hurt them not, neither was there ought missing unto them, all the while they were in Carmel.

And as the king passed by, he cried unto the king: and he said, Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle; and, behold, a man turned aside, and brought a man unto me, and said, Keep this man: if by any means he be missing, then shall thy life be for his life, or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver.

mist.en: But there went up a mist from the earth, and watered the whole face of the ground.
These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

mistress.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
And the angel of the LORD said unto her, Return to thy mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

misuse.en: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

mite.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.

mitre.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head, and put the holy crown upon the mitre.
And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

mixed.en: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

mixture.en: And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight.

For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

moabite.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

moabitess.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said, He said unto me also, Thou shalt keep fast by my young men, until they have ended all my harvest.
And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

moabitish.en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said, It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab:

mock.en: And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and smote him.
Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

mocker.en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

mocking.en: Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.
Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said,

moderately.en: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

moderation.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

modest.en: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;

moist.en: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

moisten.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

moisture.en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.

mole.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

molech.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.

mollify.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

moloch.en: But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which ye made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon.

molten.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

moment.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

money.en: And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money.
Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

monster.en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

month.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.
Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

monthly.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

monument.en: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

moon.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

more.en: And many more believed because of his own word;
I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

moreover.en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,

morning.en: And I will give him the morning star.
And the evening and the morning were the third day.

morrow.en: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:
And it came to pass on the morrow, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes,

morsel.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.

mortal.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

mortality.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

mortally.en: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

mortar.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

mortgage.en: Some also there were that said, We have mortgaged our lands, vineyards, and houses, that we might buy corn, because of the dearth.

mortify.en: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

moses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

most.en: But thou, LORD, art most high for evermore.
Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

mote.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother’s eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?

moth.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

mother.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.
Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

motion.en: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

mouldy.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet, and old garments upon them; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy.
This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you; but now, behold, it is dry, and it is mouldy:

mount.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

mountain.en: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
And in the mountains, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh,

mounted.en: And the cherubims lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went out, the wheels also were beside them, and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

mounting.en: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.

mourn.en: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
