mourner.en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

mourning.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

mouse.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the LORD.

mouth.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

move.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

mover.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

moving.en: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

mower.en: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

mowing.en: Thus hath the Lord GOD shewed unto me; and, behold, he formed grasshoppers in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.

mown.en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

much.en: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.

muffler.en: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,

mulberry.en: And when David enquired of the LORD, he said, Thou shalt not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

mule.en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty and six: their mules, two hundred forty and five:
They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.

multiply.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied.
Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

multitude.en: Then spake Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples,
And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground.

munition.en: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face: keep the munition, watch the way, make thy loins strong, fortify thy power mightily.

murder.en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
(Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)

murderer.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you;
The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

murmur.en: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
Jesus therefore answered and said unto them, Murmur not among yourselves.

murmurer.en: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

murmuring.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him: for some said, He is a good man: others said, Nay; but he deceiveth the people.

murrain.en: Behold, the hand of the LORD is upon thy cattle which is in the field, upon the horses, upon the asses, upon the camels, upon the oxen, and upon the sheep: there shall be a very grievous murrain.

mus.en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not;

muse.en: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

musical.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
And his brethren, Shemaiah, and Azarael, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God, and Ezra the scribe before them.

musician.en: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

must.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
He must increase, but I must decrease.

mustard.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:
Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:

muster.en: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

And out of the city he took an officer that was set over the men of war, and five men of them that were in the king’s presence, which were found in the city, and the principal scribe of the host, which mustered the people of the land, and threescore men of the people of the land that were found in the city:

mutter.en: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

mutual.en: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

muzzle.en: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.

my.en: I and my Father are one.
Do not err, my beloved brethren.

myrrh.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh: but he received it not.

myrtle.en: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

myself.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

mystery.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church.

nail.en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;
And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

naked.en: And he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.
If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

nakedness.en: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.

nam.en: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
And these are their names: The son of Hur, in mount Ephraim:

name.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.

namely.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

napkin.en: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I have kept laid up in a napkin:
And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.

narcissus.en: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

narrow.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.

narrower.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

narrowly.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

nation.en: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
And the gospel must first be published among all nations.

native.en: Weep ye not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goeth away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

nativity.en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
Shall I cause it to return into his sheath? I will judge thee in the place where thou wast created, in the land of thy nativity.

natural.en: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

naturally.en: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

nature.en: We who are Jews by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

naught.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray thee, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord seeth: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

naughtiness.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

naughty.en: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.

nave.en: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

navel.en: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.

navy.en: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Eziongeber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

nay.en: Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
But as God is true, our word toward you was not yea and nay.

nazarene.en: And he came and dwelt in a city called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophets, He shall be called a Nazarene.
For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

nazarite.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

near.en: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
Thou art near, O LORD; and all thy commandments are truth.

necessary.en: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

necessity.en: (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.)
Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

neck.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

necromancer.en: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

need.en: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.
But Jesus said unto them, They need not depart; give ye them to eat.

needful.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

needle.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

needlework.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, of needlework;

needs.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

needy.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

neesing.en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

neglect.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

negligent.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and be established in the present truth.
My sons, be not now negligent: for the LORD hath chosen you to stand before him, to serve him, and that ye should minister unto him, and burn incense.

nehushtan.en: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

neigh.en: They were as fed horses in the morning: every one neighed after his neighbour’s wife.

The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

neighbour.en: Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour.
Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

neighbours.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

neither.en: Neither give place to the devil.

nephew.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Israel eight years.

ner.en: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
And Kish was the father of Saul; and Ner the father of Abner was the son of Abiel.

nest.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

net.en: And they straightway left their nets, and followed him.
And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

nether.en: And Solomon built Gezer, and Bethhoron the nether,
His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

nethermost.en: The nethermost chamber was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad: for without in the wall of the house he made narrowed rests round about, that the beams should not be fastened in the walls of the house.

nethinim.en: But the Nethinims dwelt in Ophel: and Ziha and Gispa were over the Nethinims.
The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

nettles.en: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.

network.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

never.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.

nevertheless.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

new.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

newborn.en: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:

newly.en: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

So Gideon, and the hundred men that were with him, came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch; and they had but newly set the watch: and they blew the trumpets, and brake the pitchers that were in their hands.

newness.en: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

news.en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

next.en: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

nicolaitan.en: But this thou hast, that thou hatest the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate.

nigh.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
Now Bethany was nigh unto Jerusalem, about fifteen furlongs off:

night.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

nine.en: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

nineteen.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
And Iron, and Migdalel, Horem, and Bethanath, and Bethshemesh; nineteen cities with their villages.

nineteenth.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

ninety.en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.
The children of Gibeon, ninety and five.

ninth.en: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
The ninth to Jeshuah, the tenth to Shecaniah,

nisan.en: And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it unto the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.

In the first month, that is, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of king Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, to the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar.

nitre.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre, and take thee much soap, yet thine iniquity is marked before me, saith the Lord GOD.
As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.

no.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

noah.en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,

nob.en: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

noble.en: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

nobleman.en: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

nod.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the LORD, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.

noise.en: Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

noisome.en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

non.en: Non his son, Jehoshuah his son,

none.en: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

noon.en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

noonday.en: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

noontide.en: And let that man be as the cities which the LORD overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

nor.en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
Thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

north.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

northern.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?

But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.

northward.en: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward, and went down unto Arabah:

nose.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.

nostril.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

notable.en: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before that great and notable day of the Lord come:

note.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.
Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:

noted.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

nothing.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible.
If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

notice.en: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof ye had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.

nought.en: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

nourish.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
And when he was cast out, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son.

nourisher.en: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

nourishing.en: And the king appointed them a daily provision of the king’s meat, and of the wine which he drank: so nourishing them three years, that at the end thereof they might stand before the king.

nourishment.en: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.

novice.en: Not a novice, lest being lifted up with pride he fall into the condemnation of the devil.

now.en: Jesus answered them, Do ye now believe?
Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

number.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

numbers.en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the LORD.

nun.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died, being an hundred and ten years old.

nurse.en: But we were gentle among you, even as a nurse cherisheth her children:
And Naomi took the child, and laid it in her bosom, and became nurse unto it.

nursing.en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.

nurture.en: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

nut.en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, and to see whether the vine flourished, and the pomegranates budded.

And their father Israel said unto them, If it must be so now, do this; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels, and carry down the man a present, a little balm, and a little honey, spices, and myrrh, nuts, and almonds:

nympha.en: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.

o.en: I will love thee, O LORD, my strength.
Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

oak.en: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

oar.en: And all that handle the oar, the mariners, and all the pilots of the sea, shall come down from their ships, they shall stand upon the land;
Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory, brought out of the isles of Chittim.

oath.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

obe.en: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.

obedience.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

obedient.en: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

obeisance.en: And Bathsheba bowed, and did obeisance unto the king. And the king said, What wouldest thou?
And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

obey.en: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
Ye did run well; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth?

object.en: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

oblation.en: All the people of the land shall give this oblation for the prince in Israel.
And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

oboe.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

obscure.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.

obscurity.en: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.

observation.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:

observe.en: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.
They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.

observer.en: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do.
There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.

obstinate.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

obtain.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

occasion.en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

occupation.en: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?
And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

occupier.en: Thy riches, and thy fairs, thy merchandise, thy mariners, and thy pilots, thy calkers, and the occupiers of thy merchandise, and all thy men of war, that are in thee, and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee, shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin.

occupy.en: And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come.
Dan also and Javan going to and fro occupied in thy fairs: bright iron, cassia, and calamus, were in thy market.

occurrent.en: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.

od.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the LORD, that was before the porch of the LORD.

odd.en: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

odious.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.

And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syriamaachah, and out of Zobah.

odour.en: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.

odours.en: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him.

of.en: I am that bread of life.
And the sons of Dan; Hushim.

off.en: For the LORD will not cast off for ever:
I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

offence.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

offend.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

offender.en: Otherwise it shall come to pass, when my lord the king shall sleep with his fathers, that I and my son Solomon shall be counted offenders.
That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.

offer.en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

offering.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

office.en: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

officer.en: The officers answered, Never man spake like this man.
Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people, saying,

offscouring.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

offspring.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

oft.en: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:

often.en: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
Drink no longer water, but use a little wine for thy stomach’s sake and thine often infirmities.

oftentimes.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

ofttimes.en: And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples.
Lord, have mercy on my son: for he is lunatick, and sore vexed: for ofttimes he falleth into the fire, and oft into the water.

oh.en: And Lot said unto them, Oh, not so, my LORD:
But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

oil.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

oiled.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

ointment.en: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
Let thy garments be always white; and let thy head lack no ointment.

old.en: So Job died, being old and full of days.
And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?

oldness.en: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

olive.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

omega.en: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, saith the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

omer.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations.

omnipotent.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth.

on.en: And many believed on him there.
Of sin, because they believe not on me;

once.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

one.en: I and my Father are one.
One Lord, one faith, one baptism,

ones.en: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

onion.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

only.en: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

onward.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys:

onycha.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

onyx.en: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.

open.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,

opening.en: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

openly.en: Him God raised up the third day, and shewed him openly;
Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews.

operation.en: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

opinion.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

opportunity.en: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude.

oppose.en: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;

opposition.en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

oppress.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

oppression.en: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.
Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

oppressor.en: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

or.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

oracle.en: And within the oracle he made two cherubims of olive tree, each ten cubits high.
Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

oration.en: And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them.

orator.en: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counsellor, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders, and with a certain orator named Tertullus, who informed the governor against Paul.

orchard.en: I made me gardens and orchards, and I planted trees in them of all kind of fruits:
Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

ordain.en: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
LORD, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.

order.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.
Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

ordering.en: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

orderly.en: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.

ordinance.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

ordinary.en: Behold, therefore I have stretched out my hand over thee, and have diminished thine ordinary food, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, which are ashamed of thy lewd way.

organ.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

orion.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

ornament.en: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

orphan.en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

ospray.en: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

ossifrage.en: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

ostrich.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

other.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.
The men of the other Nebo, fifty and two.

otherwise.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid.
For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

ouch.en: And thou shalt make ouches of gold;
And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

ought.en: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

our.en: For ye are our glory and joy.
For our God is a consuming fire.

ours.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

ourselves.en: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

out.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
And they cried out again, Crucify him.

outcast.en: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.
The Lord GOD, which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.

outer.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
But the children of the kingdom shall be cast out into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

outgoing.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

outlandish.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? yet among many nations was there no king like him, who was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel: nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin.

outlive.en: And the people served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great works of the LORD, that he did for Israel.

outmost.en: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

outrageous.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

outrun.en: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.

outside.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
And he said unto them, Look on me, and do likewise: and, behold, when I come to the outside of the camp, it shall be that, as I do, so shall ye do.

outstretch.en: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terribleness, and with signs, and with wonders:

outward.en: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

outwent.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

oven.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.

over.en: So king Solomon was king over all Israel.
Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

overcharge.en: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.
And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

overcome.en: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

overdrive.en: And he said unto him, My lord knoweth that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with young are with me: and if men should overdrive them one day, all the flock will die.

overflow.en: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

overflowing.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

overlay.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

overlaying.en: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

overlive.en: And Israel served the LORD all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders that overlived Joshua, and which had known all the works of the LORD, that he had done for Israel.

overmuch.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him, and comfort him, lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow.

overpass.en: They are waxen fat, they shine: yea, they overpass the deeds of the wicked: they judge not the cause, the cause of the fatherless, yet they prosper; and the right of the needy do they not judge.

overplus.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

oversee.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

overseer.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
And Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer: and Judah the son of Senuah was second over the city.

overshadow.en: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

oversight.en: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chief of the Levites, had the oversight of the outward business of the house of God.
And before this, Eliashib the priest, having the oversight of the chamber of the house of our God, was allied unto Tobiah:

overspread.en: These are the three sons of Noah: and of them was the whole earth overspread.

And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

overtake.en: But ye, brethren, are not in darkness, that that day should overtake you as a thief.
All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.

overthrow.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

overturn.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

overwhelm.en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

owe.en: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;
And when he had begun to reckon, one was brought unto him, which owed him ten thousand talents.

owl.en: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

own.en: And every man went unto his own house.
For every man shall bear his own burden.

owner.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

ox.en: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.

pac.en: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

pacify.en: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

paddle.en: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:

paid.en: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

pain.en: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

painful.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

pains.en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

paint.en: And furthermore, that ye have sent for men to come from far, unto whom a messenger was sent; and, lo, they came: for whom thou didst wash thyself, paintedst thy eyes, and deckedst thyself with ornaments,

painted.en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.
That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

painting.en: And when thou art spoiled, what wilt thou do? Though thou clothest thyself with crimson, though thou deckest thee with ornaments of gold, though thou rentest thy face with painting, in vain shalt thou make thyself fair; thy lovers will despise thee, they will seek thy life.

pair.en: That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?
And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

palace.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

pale.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.

And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

paleness.en: Ask ye now, and see whether a man doth travail with child? wherefore do I see every man with his hands on his loins, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

palm.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters of grapes.

palmerworm.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.

palsy.en: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.
And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.

pan.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.

pang.en: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? is there no king in thee? is thy counsellor perished? for pangs have taken thee as a woman in travail.
The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

pant.en: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.
As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

pap.en: Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.
For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

paper.en: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

parable.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
And he spake this parable unto them, saying,

paradise.en: And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise.
How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

paramours.en: For she doted upon their paramours, whose flesh is as the flesh of asses, and whose issue is like the issue of horses.

parcel.en: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great deliverance.

parch.en: And they did eat of the old corn of the land on the morrow after the passover, unleavened cakes, and parched corn in the selfsame day.
Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

parchment.en: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.

pardon.en: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

pare.en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;

parent.en: Therefore said his parents, He is of age; ask him.
Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

parlour.en: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.

parlours.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

part.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

partake.en: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

partaker.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

parted.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.

parthian.en: Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia,

partial.en: Are ye not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
Therefore have I also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according as ye have not kept my ways, but have been partial in the law.

partiality.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
I charge thee before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the elect angels, that thou observe these things without preferring one before another, doing nothing by partiality.

particular.en: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

particularly.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.

parting.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made his arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.

partition.en: For he is our peace, who hath made both one, and hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
So Solomon overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he made a partition by the chains of gold before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.

partly.en: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
And as the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

partner.en: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.

partridge.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
Now therefore, let not my blood fall to the earth before the face of the LORD: for the king of Israel is come out to seek a flea, as when one doth hunt a partridge in the mountains.

pass.en: And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.
And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by.

passage.en: And the garrison of the Philistines went out to the passage of Michmash.
Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

passenger.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
And the passengers that pass through the land, when any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamongog.

passing.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas.
But he passing through the midst of them went his way,

passion.en: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

passover.en: And the passover, a feast of the Jews, was nigh.
And the Jews’ passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem,

past.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

pastor.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

pasture.en: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.
The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

pate.en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

path.en: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

pathway.en: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

patience.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

patient.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.

patiently.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

patriarch.en: And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him,
Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

patrimony.en: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

pattern.en: And look that thou make them after their pattern, which was shewed thee in the mount.
In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

pau.en: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

paul.en: So Paul departed from among them.
The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.

pave.en: And they saw the God of Israel: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
He made the pillars thereof of silver, the bottom thereof of gold, the covering of it of purple, the midst thereof being paved with love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.

pavement.en: And the pavement by the side of the gates over against the length of the gates was the lower pavement.
Then brought he me into the outward court, and, lo, there were chambers, and a pavement made for the court round about: thirty chambers were upon the pavement.

pavilion.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

paw.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

pay.en: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

payment.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

peace.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
And the way of peace have they not known:

peaceable.en: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

peacemaker.en: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

peacock.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

pearl.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

peculiar.en: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.
Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

pedigree.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

peel.en: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyrus: every head was made bald, and every shoulder was peeled: yet had he no wages, nor his army, for Tyrus, for the service that he had served against it:

That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!

peep.en: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?

And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.

pelican.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

pen.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto thee:

pence.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty.

penknife.en: And it came to pass, that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, he cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth, until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth.

penny.en: Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.
Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it? They answered and said, Caesar’s.

pennyworth.en: Philip answered him, Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may take a little.
He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

pentecost.en: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

penury.en: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.

people.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

per.en: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

peradventure.en: And I said unto my master, Peradventure the woman will not follow me.
For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

perceive.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

perdition.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goeth into perdition.

perfect.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.
God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.

perfection.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

perfectly.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night.
And besought him that they might only touch the hem of his garment: and as many as touched were made perfectly whole.

perfectness.en: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

perform.en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.
I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

performance.en: And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

perfume.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

perhaps.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that thou shouldest receive him for ever;
Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

peril.en: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

perilous.en: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

perish.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!

perjured.en: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

permission.en: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.

permit.en: And this will we do, if God permit.
For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.

pernicious.en: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

perpetual.en: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

perpetually.en: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

And the LORD said unto him, I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, that thou hast made before me: I have hallowed this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually.

perplexed.en: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

perplexity.en: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

persecute.en: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;

persecution.en: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.
Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.

persecutor.en: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.
He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

perseverance.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

persian.en: PERES; Thy kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.
So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

persis.en: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

person.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.

persuade.en: Saying, This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law.
Then Agrippa said unto Paul, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

persuaded.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

persuasion.en: This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you.

pertain.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah, and came to Jerusalem.
The son of Hesed, in Aruboth; to him pertained Sochoh, and all the land of Hepher:

perverse.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.

perversely.en: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

And said unto the king, Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me, neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, that the king should take it to his heart.

perverseness.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

pervert.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

pestilence.en: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
So the LORD sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.

pestilent.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

pestle.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.

peter.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.

petition.en: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
And now I ask one petition of thee, deny me not. And she said unto him, Say on.

pharaoh.en: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old art thou?
And he went out from Pharaoh, and intreated the LORD.

phare.en: And Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar; and Phares begat Esrom; and Esrom begat Aram;
Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda,

pharisee.en: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
Then answered them the Pharisees, Are ye also deceived?

phebe.en: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

philip.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
Philip saith unto him, Lord, shew us the Father, and it sufficeth us.

philippian.en: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

philistine.en: And Abraham sojourned in the Philistines’ land many days.
