And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years.

philologue.en: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

philosopher.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

philosophy.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

physician.en: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

pick.en: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

picture.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.

piece.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

pierce.en: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
(Yea, a sword shall pierce through thy own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

pierced.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
And again another scripture saith, They shall look on him whom they pierced.

piercing.en: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
In that day the LORD with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

piety.en: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

pigeon.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

pile.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.

For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.

pilgrim.en: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

pilgrimage.en: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
And I have also established my covenant with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their pilgrimage, wherein they were strangers.

pillar.en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

pilled.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.

pillow.en: And when the messengers were come in, behold, there was an image in the bed, with a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster.
And Michal took an image, and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair for his bolster, and covered it with a cloth.

pilot.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners: thy wise men, O Tyrus, that were in thee, were thy pilots.

pin.en: The pins of the tabernacle, and the pins of the court, and their cords,
And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

pine.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.
And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

pining.en: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.

pinnacle.en: Then the devil taketh him up into the holy city, and setteth him on a pinnacle of the temple,
And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

pinon.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,

pip.en: And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.
And I answered again, and said unto him, What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves?

pipe.en: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the LORD, neither consider the operation of his hands.

piped.en: And saying, We have piped unto you, and ye have not danced; we have mourned unto you, and ye have not lamented.
And all the people came up after him, and the people piped with pipes, and rejoiced with great joy, so that the earth rent with the sound of them.

piper.en: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;

piss.en: So and more also do God unto the enemies of David, if I leave of all that pertain to him by the morning light any that pisseth against the wall.
For the whole house of Ahab shall perish: and I will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Israel:

pit.en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

pitch.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
So Israel and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

pitcher.en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said, Let me, I pray thee, drink a little water of thy pitcher.
And she said, Drink, my lord: and she hasted, and let down her pitcher upon her hand, and gave him drink.

pitiful.en: Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

pity.en: Then thou shalt cut off her hand, thine eye shall not pity her.
Then will the LORD be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

place.en: Neither give place to the devil.
And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

plague.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

plain.en: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
Teach me thy way, O LORD, and lead me in a plain path, because of mine enemies.

plainly.en: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me.

plainness.en: Seeing then that we have such hope, we use great plainness of speech:

plaister.en: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

plait.en: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

plan.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.

planet.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places round about Jerusalem; them also that burned incense unto Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the host of heaven.

plank.en: And there were narrow windows and palm trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch, and upon the side chambers of the house, and thick planks.
And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubims and palm trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick planks upon the face of the porch without.

plant.en: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

plantation.en: There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers: and, behold, this vine did bend her roots toward him, and shot forth her branches toward him, that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation.

planted.en: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

planter.en: Thou shalt yet plant vines upon the mountains of Samaria: the planters shall plant, and shall eat them as common things.

planting.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.

plat.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

plate.en: And thou shalt make a plate of pure gold, and grave upon it, like the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.
And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE LORD.

platt.en: And they clothed him with purple, and platted a crown of thorns, and put it about his head,
And the soldiers platted a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe,

platter.en: Thou blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
And the Lord said unto him, Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness.

play.en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?

player.en: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.
The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

playing.en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof.
The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

plea.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

plead.en: The LORD standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

pleadings.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

pleasant.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

pleasantness.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

please.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

pleased.en: Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still.
And their words pleased Hamor, and Shechem Hamor’s son.

pleasing.en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

pleasure.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

pledge.en: And if the man be poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:
They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

pleiades.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

plenteous.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

plentiful.en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
And I brought you into a plentiful country, to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof; but when ye entered, ye defiled my land, and made mine heritage an abomination.

plenty.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:

plough.en: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.

plow.en: Thou shalt not plow with an ox and an ass together.
The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

plower.en: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

plowman.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?

Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

plowshare.en: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

pluck.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

plucked.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

plummet.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

plunge.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

poet.en: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.

point.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

pointed.en: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.

poison.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.

pole.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

policy.en: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

polished.en: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;

polishing.en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

poll.en: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.

polled.en: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.

pollute.en: My face will I turn also from them, and they shall pollute my secret place: for the robbers shall enter into it, and defile it.
And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall pollute it.

polluted.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

polluting.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the LORD, to serve him, and to love the name of the LORD, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;

pollution.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers’ nakedness: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution.
But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood.

pollux.en: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.

pomegranate.en: As a piece of a pomegranate are thy temples within thy locks.
Thy plants are an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,

pommel.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

pomp.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
For I will lay the land most desolate, and the pomp of her strength shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, that none shall pass through.

pond.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
And the LORD spake unto Moses, Say unto Aaron, Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams, over the rivers, and over the ponds, and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt.

ponder.en: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.

pool.en: I made me pools of water, to water therewith the wood that bringeth forth trees:
Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

poor.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause.

poplar.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chestnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

populous.en: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

And thou shalt speak and say before the LORD thy God, A Syrian ready to perish was my father, and he went down into Egypt, and sojourned there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and populous:

porch.en: And Jesus walked in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

port.en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.

porter.en: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king’s house within.
In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.

portion.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
The LORD is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

possess.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

possession.en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

possessor.en: And he blessed him, and said, Blessed be Abram of the most high God, possessor of heaven and earth:
And Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have lift up mine hand unto the LORD, the most high God, the possessor of heaven and earth,

possible.en: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

post.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

posterity.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

pot.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

potentate.en: Which in his times he shall shew, who is the blessed and only Potentate, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

potsherd.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

pottage.en: And Jacob sod pottage: and Esau came from the field, and he was faint:
And Esau said to Jacob, Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint: therefore was his name called Edom.

potter.en: And gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord appointed me.
Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

pound.en: (And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.)
Then came the first, saying, Lord, thy pound hath gained ten pounds.

pour.en: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

poured.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

poureth.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

pouring.en: And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

And it came to pass, while they were slaying them, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said, Ah Lord GOD! wilt thou destroy all the residue of Israel in thy pouring out of thy fury upon Jerusalem?

pourtray.en: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:
And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,

poverty.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.

powder.en: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken: but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.

power.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
For the kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

powerful.en: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is full of majesty.
For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

practic.en: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

practise.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

praetorium.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall, called Praetorium; and they call together the whole band.

praise.en: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
Praise ye the LORD. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

prate.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

prayer.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

praying.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense.

preach.en: And there they preached the gospel.
To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.

preacher.en: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.
Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.

preaching.en: In those days came John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea,
Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word.

precept.en: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.
And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

precious.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots.
Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.

predestinate.en: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

preeminence.en: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

prefer.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

premeditate.en: But when they shall lead you, and deliver you up, take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak, neither do ye premeditate: but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour, that speak ye: for it is not ye that speak, but the Holy Ghost.

preparation.en: And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on.
And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

prepare.en: And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?
If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

prepared.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people;
And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek the LORD.

presbytery.en: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.

prescribe.en: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

presence.en: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

present.en: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you.

presently.en: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

preserve.en: Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.
Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

preserver.en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

president.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
And over these three presidents; of whom Daniel was first: that the princes might give accounts unto them, and the king should have no damage.

press.en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

presume.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

presumptuous.en: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

presumptuously.en: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.
But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; thou shalt take him from mine altar, that he may die.

pretence.en: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayers: these shall receive greater damnation.
What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

prevail.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
And Solomon went to Hamathzobah, and prevailed against it.

prevent.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

prey.en: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

price.en: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.

prick.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
And he said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest: it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks.

pricking.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel, nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them, that despised them; and they shall know that I am the Lord GOD.

pride.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

priest.en: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?
And having an high priest over the house of God;

priesthood.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

prince.en: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?

princess.en: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

principal.en: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.
Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

principality.en: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

principle.en: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Christ, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward God,

For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

print.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD.

prised.en: And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.

prison.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
And he sent, and beheaded John in the prison.

prisoner.en: And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.
To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,

private.en: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

privately.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.
And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

privily.en: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

privy.en: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

prize.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

proceed.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

proceeding.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

process.en: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.

proclaim.en: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.
And Jehu said, Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal. And they proclaimed it.

proclamation.en: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to the LORD.
And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

procure.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
Hast thou not procured this unto thyself, in that thou hast forsaken the LORD thy God, when he led thee by the way?

produce.en: Produce your cause, saith the LORD; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.

profane.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things, and hast profaned my sabbaths.
But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.

profaneness.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

profess.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.

professed.en: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

profession.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus;

profit.en: Behold, ye trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

profitable.en: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:

profiting.en: Meditate upon these things; give thyself wholly to them; that thy profiting may appear to all.

profound.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

progenitor.en: The blessings of thy father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

prognosticator.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.

prolong.en: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.
The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

promise.en: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

promising.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:

promote.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.

promotion.en: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

pronounce.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

pronounced.en: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words unto me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.
And the captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said unto him, The LORD thy God hath pronounced this evil upon this place.

pronouncing.en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.

proof.en: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

proper.en: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man hath his proper gift of God, one after this manner, and another after that.
And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood.

prophecy.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

prophesy.en: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

prophet.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

prophetess.en: And Deborah, a prophetess, the wife of Lapidoth, she judged Israel at that time.
And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the LORD to me, Call his name Mahershalalhashbaz.

propitiation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
Herein is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

proportion.en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

proselyte.en: Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes,
Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

prospect.en: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
And he said unto me, This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.

prosper.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.
Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

prosperity.en: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

prosperous.en: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
And the man wondering at her held his peace, to wit whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

prostitute.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

protection.en: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

protest.en: And the angel of the LORD protested unto Joshua, saying,
I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.

proud.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.

proudly.en: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,

prove.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

provender.en: She said moreover unto him, We have both straw and provender enough, and room to lodge in.
So he brought him into his house, and gave provender unto the asses: and they washed their feet, and did eat and drink.

proverb.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

provide.en: Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,
Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

provided.en: God having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

providence.en: And when he was called forth, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness, and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence,

province.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
Now when Festus was come into the province, after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem.

provision.en: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
And Solomon’s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and threescore measures of meal,

provocation.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

provoke.en: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

provoking.en: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

prudence.en: Wherein he hath abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

prudent.en: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

prudently.en: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.

prune.en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

pruning.en: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

psalm.en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

psalmist.en: Now these be the last words of David. David the son of Jesse said, and the man who was raised up on high, the anointed of the God of Jacob, and the sweet psalmist of Israel, said,

psaltery.en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

publican.en: Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners for to hear him.
Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do?

publish.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations.
And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

puff.en: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.
Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

pull.en: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

pulled.en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
But the men put forth their hand, and pulled Lot into the house to them, and shut to the door.

pulpit.en: And Ezra the scribe stood upon a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Urijah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchiah, and Hashum, and Hashbadana, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

pulse.en: Prove thy servants, I beseech thee, ten days; and let them give us pulse to eat, and water to drink.
Thus Melzar took away the portion of their meat, and the wine that they should drink; and gave them pulse.

punish.en: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

punishment.en: And Cain said unto the LORD, My punishment is greater than I can bear.
To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

pur.en: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

purchase.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth: there was Abraham buried, and Sarah his wife.

pure.en: Holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.
Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

purely.en: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

pureness.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

purge.en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

purging.en: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

purification.en: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.
And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord;

purifier.en: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

purify.en: And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith.
Seven days shall they purge the altar and purify it; and they shall consecrate themselves.

purim.en: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

purity.en: The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity.
Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.

purloin.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

purple.en: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

purpose.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.

purse.en: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
Provide neither gold, nor silver, nor brass in your purses,

pursue.en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

pursuer.en: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
And they went, and came unto the mountain, and abode there three days, until the pursuers were returned: and the pursuers sought them throughout all the way, but found them not.

purtenance.en: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.

push.en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

pushing.en: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

put.en: And he put them all together into ward three days.
Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

putrify.en: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.

putt.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

putting.en: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

pygarg.en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

quail.en: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

quake.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

quaking.en: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

quantity.en: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.

quarrel.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:
Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

quarter.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.

quaternion.en: And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people.

queen.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.

quench.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

question.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.

quick.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

quicken.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

quickening.en: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

quickly.en: As soon as she heard that, she arose quickly, and came unto him.
The second woe is past; and, behold, the third woe cometh quickly.

quicksand.en: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

quiet.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

quietly.en: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

quietness.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

quit.en: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
And if thou utter this our business, then we will be quit of thine oath which thou hast made us to swear.

quite.en: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
Are we not counted of him strangers? for he hath sold us, and hath quite devoured also our money.

quiver.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.
He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

quivered.en: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

rabbi.en: And Rabbith, and Kishion, and Abez,
And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

raca.en: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

race.en: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.
Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.

rafter.en: The beams of our house are cedar, and our rafters of fir.

rag.en: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

rage.en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.

ragged.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the LORD, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.

raging.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

rail.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If thou be Christ, save thyself and us.
And they that passed by railed on him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ah, thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days,

railer.en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

railing.en: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

raiment.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.

rain.en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;
He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

rainbow.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.
And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

rainy.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.

rais.en: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

raise.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

raised.en: But God raised him from the dead:
But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

raiser.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

raisin.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him: for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.

Then Abigail made haste, and took two hundred loaves, and two bottles of wine, and five sheep ready dressed, and five measures of parched corn, and an hundred clusters of raisins, and two hundred cakes of figs, and laid them on asses.

raising.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
And they neither found me in the temple disputing with any man, neither raising up the people, neither in the synagogues, nor in the city:

ram.en: And Hezron begat Ram, and Ram begat Amminadab,
And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

rampart.en: Art thou better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

ran.en: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,
And the damsel ran, and told them of her mother’s house these things.

rang.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
And when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came into the camp, all Israel shouted with a great shout, so that the earth rang again.

range.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

rank.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
And there were windows in three rows, and light was against light in three ranks.

ransom.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.

rare.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth, and there is none other that can shew it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

rase.en: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

rash.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
Be not rash with thy mouth, and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God: for God is in heaven, and thou upon earth: therefore let thy words be few.

rashly.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.

rate.en: And his allowance was a continual allowance given him of the king, a daily rate for every day, all the days of his life.
And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

rather.en: But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious?

rattle.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

raven.en: And every raven after his kind,

ravening.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

ravenous.en: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.

ravin.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

ravish.en: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.
And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

raw.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

razor.en: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
And thou, son of man, take thee a sharp knife, take thee a barber’s razor, and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard: then take thee balances to weigh, and divide the hair.

reach.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.

read.en: Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation.
He said unto him, What is written in the law? how readest thou?

readiness.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which ye have.

reading.en: Till I come, give attendance to reading, to exhortation, to doctrine.
So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

ready.en: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

realm.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his God gave him rest round about.
In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

reap.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

reaper.en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers, Whose damsel is this?
And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

rear.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.

reason.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

reasonable.en: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

reasoning.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.

rebel.en: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken it.
They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

rebellion.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

rebellious.en: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

rebuke.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
Them that sin rebuke before all, that others also may fear.

rebuker.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

recall.en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

receipt.en: And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me.
And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

receive.en: I receive not honour from men.
He came unto his own, and his own received him not.

receiver.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?

rechabite.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine, and cups, and I said unto them, Drink ye wine.
Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

reckon.en: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

reckoning.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.

recommend.en: And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God.
And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled.

recompence.en: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.

recompense.en: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

reconcile.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled

reconciliation.en: And all things are of God, who hath reconciled us to himself by Jesus Christ, and hath given to us the ministry of reconciliation;
To wit, that God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself, not imputing their trespasses unto them; and hath committed unto us the word of reconciliation.

record.en: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

recorder.en: And Adoram was over the tribute: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder:
And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

recount.en: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

recover.en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.

red.en: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

reddish.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

redeem.en: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

redeemer.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
As for our redeemer, the LORD of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

redness.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?

redound.en: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.

reed.en: He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.
He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.

reel.en: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.
The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

refine.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It is my people: and they shall say, The LORD is my God.

refined.en: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

refiner.en: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:
And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

reformation.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

reformed.en: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

refrain.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

refresh.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
Yea, brother, let me have joy of thee in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

refreshing.en: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;

refuge.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

refuse.en: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
For if thou refuse to let them go, and wilt hold them still,

regard.en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me:
Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

regarding.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

regeneration.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

region.en: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region.

register.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but it was not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.
These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

rehearse.en: And Samuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of the LORD.
But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying,

rei.en: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet, and Shimei, and Rei, and the mighty men which belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.

reign.en: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

reins.en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

reject.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

rejoice.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

rejoicing.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

release.en: I will therefore chastise him, and release him.
At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

relief.en: Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea:

relieve.en: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.

religion.en: Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.
If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.

religious.en: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God.

rely.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Judah prevailed, because they relied upon the LORD God of their fathers.
Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because thou didst rely on the LORD, he delivered them into thine hand.
