remain.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.
Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

remainder.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

reme.en: And Remeth, and Engannim, and Enhaddah, and Bethpazzez;

remedy.en: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

remembrance.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

remission.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins,

remit.en: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.

remnant.en: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
And the remnant took his servants, and entreated them spitefully, and slew them.

remove.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

removed.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

rend.en: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

render.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

rendering.en: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.

renew.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

renounce.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

renown.en: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it was perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

renowned.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.

rent.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

repair.en: And after him repaired the priests, the men of the plain.
But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.

repairer.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

repay.en: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

repeat.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

repent.en: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

repentance.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance:
For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

repetition.en: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.

replenish.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

report.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the LORD revealed?

reproach.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.
Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

reprobate.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.
Reprobate silver shall men call them, because the LORD hath rejected them.

reproof.en: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

reprove.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

reprover.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth, that thou shalt be dumb, and shalt not be to them a reprover: for they are a rebellious house.

reputation.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

repute.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and none can stay his hand, or say unto him, What doest thou?

request.en: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

require.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

requite.en: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
It may be that the LORD will look on mine affliction, and that the LORD will requite me good for his cursing this day.

rereward.en: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the LORD will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds, and by thousands: but David and his men passed on in the rereward with Achish.

rescue.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away: and David rescued his two wives.
Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

resemblance.en: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah that goeth forth. He said moreover, This is their resemblance through all the earth.

resemble.en: Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and whereunto shall I resemble it?
Then said he unto Zebah and Zalmunna, What manner of men were they whom ye slew at Tabor? And they answered, As thou art, so were they; each one resembled the children of a king.

reserve.en: Will he reserve his anger for ever? will he keep it to the end? Behold, thou hast spoken and done evil things as thou couldest.
The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

reserved.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

residue.en: And they went and told it unto the residue: neither believed they them.
But now I will not be unto the residue of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.

resist.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.

resolved.en: I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses.

resort.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

respect.en: For there is no respect of persons with God.
I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

respecter.en: Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons:

respite.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite, he hardened his heart, and hearkened not unto them; as the LORD had said.
And the elders of Jabesh said unto him, Give us seven days’ respite, that we may send messengers unto all the coasts of Israel: and then, if there be no man to save us, we will come out to thee.

rest.en: So the people rested on the seventh day.
There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God.

resting.en: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;

restitution.en: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God hath spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began.

restore.en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.
But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

restorer.en: And he shall be unto thee a restorer of thy life, and a nourisher of thine old age: for thy daughter in law, which loveth thee, which is better to thee than seven sons, hath born him.

And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

restrain.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

restraint.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that the LORD will work for us: for there is no restraint to the LORD to save by many or by few.

resurrection.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

retain.en: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

retire.en: Set up the standard toward Zion: retire, stay not: for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.
And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire ye from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

retired.en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle, Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons: for they said, Surely they are smitten down before us, as in the first battle.

Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom. And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and cast it out to Joab. And he blew a trumpet, and they retired from the city, every man to his tent. And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king.

return.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir.
Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.

reveal.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed.
And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.

revealer.en: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, Of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, seeing thou couldest reveal this secret.

revelation.en: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.

revenge.en: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because the Philistines have dealt by revenge, and have taken vengeance with a despiteful heart, to destroy it for the old hatred;

revenger.en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

revenging.en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

revenue.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

reverence.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.
Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD.

reverend.en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

reverse.en: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.

revile.en: And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads,
And they that stood by said, Revilest thou God’s high priest?

reviler.en: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.

reviling.en: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

revive.en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

reviving.en: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.

For we were bondmen; yet our God hath not forsaken us in our bondage, but hath extended mercy unto us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to give us a reviving, to set up the house of our God, and to repair the desolations thereof, and to give us a wall in Judah and in Jerusalem.

revolt.en: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

revolter.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

revolting.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart; they are revolted and gone.

reward.en: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

rewarder.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

rib.en: And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.
And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

ribband.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

rich.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

riches.en: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

richly.en: Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

rid.en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

riddance.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’s wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

ridden.en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

riddle.en: Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel;
And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.

ride.en: Speak, ye that ride on white asses, ye that sit in judgment, and walk by the way.
Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

rider.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

ridge.en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

riding.en: Which were clothed with blue, captains and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding upon horses.
Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not thy riding for me, except I bid thee.

rie.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?

rifle.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.

right.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.

righteous.en: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

righteously.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

righteousness.en: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.

rightly.en: Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, Thou hast rightly judged.
Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.

rigour.en: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
And the Egyptians made the children of Israel to serve with rigour:

ring.en: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

ringleader.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow, and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes:

ringstraked.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
And he said, Lift up now thine eyes, and see, all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked, speckled, and grisled: for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee.

rinse.en: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

riot.en: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
Wherein they think it strange that ye run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

riotous.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.

rip.en: And Hazael said, Why weepeth my lord? And he answered, Because I know the evil that thou wilt do unto the children of Israel: their strong holds wilt thou set on fire, and their young men wilt thou slay with the sword, and wilt dash their children, and rip up their women with child.

ripe.en: Thou shalt not delay to offer the first of thy ripe fruits, and of thy liquors: the firstborn of thy sons shalt thou give unto me.
Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

ripen.en: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.

ris.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

rise.en: Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

risen.en: The sun was risen upon the earth when Lot entered into Zoar.
Saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and hath appeared to Simon.

rising.en: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

rit.en: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

river.en: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

road.en: And Achish said, Whither have ye made a road to day? And David said, Against the south of Judah, and against the south of the Jerahmeelites, and against the south of the Kenites.

roar.en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.

roaring.en: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

roast.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.

rob.en: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me. But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee? In tithes and offerings.

robber.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

robbery.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.

robe.en: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
And thou shalt make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

rock.en: For who is God save the LORD? or who is a rock save our God?
For who is God, save the LORD? and who is a rock, save our God?

rod.en: I AM the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

rode.en: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.
And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

roe.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.

roebuck.en: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

roll.en: So I opened my mouth, and he caused me to eat that roll.
And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

roller.en: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it shall not be bound up to be healed, to put a roller to bind it, to make it strong to hold the sword.

rolling.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.

roman.en: Then the chief captain came, and said unto him, Tell me, art thou a Roman? He said, Yea.
And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans.

roof.en: And before they were laid down, she came up unto them upon the roof;
The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

room.en: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.

root.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

rooted.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love,

rope.en: Then the soldiers cut off the ropes of the boat, and let her fall off.
Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:

rose.en: And he left all, rose up, and followed him.
I am the rose of Sharon, and the lily of the valleys.

rot.en: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

rotten.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

rough.en: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.

roughly.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

round.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

rouse.en: Judah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

rover.en: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

row.en: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

rowed.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not: for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous against them.
So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs, they see Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing nigh unto the ship: and they were afraid.

rower.en: Thy rowers have brought thee into great waters: the east wind hath broken thee in the midst of the seas.

royal.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

rubbing.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

rubbish.en: And Judah said, The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.

And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria, and said, What do these feeble Jews? will they fortify themselves? will they sacrifice? will they make an end in a day? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned?

rudder.en: And when they had taken up the anchors, they committed themselves unto the sea, and loosed the rudder bands, and hoised up the mainsail to the wind, and made toward shore.

ruddy.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
And when the Philistine looked about, and saw David, he disdained him: for he was but a youth, and ruddy, and of a fair countenance.

rude.en: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

rudiment.en: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.

rue.en: But woe unto you, Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love of God: these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

ruin.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

ruinous.en: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
Hast thou not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

rule.en: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:
Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

ruler.en: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
And Ira also the Jairite was a chief ruler about David.

ruling.en: Let the deacons be the husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.
The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spake to me, He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

rumbling.en: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

rumour.en: And this rumour of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about.
Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

rumours.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars, be ye not troubled: for such things must needs be; but the end shall not be yet.
And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

rump.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

run.en: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

running.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.

rush.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

rushed.en: And the liers in wait hasted, and rushed upon Gibeah; and the liers in wait drew themselves along, and smote all the city with the edge of the sword.
And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

rust.en: Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal:
But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

ruth.en: And Salmon begat Booz of Rachab; and Booz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;
And they lifted up their voice, and wept again: and Orpah kissed her mother in law; but Ruth clave unto her.

s.en: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.

sabaoth.en: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.

sabbath.en: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day.

sabean.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the LORD hath spoken it.

sacar.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,

sack.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
And other money have we brought down in our hands to buy food: we cannot tell who put our money in our sacks.

sackbut.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:

Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:

sackcloth.en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

sacrific.en: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before the LORD.

sacrifice.en: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.
And the king, and all Israel with him, offered sacrifice before the LORD.

sacrilege.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

sad.en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.
And Joseph came in unto them in the morning, and looked upon them, and, behold, they were sad.

saddle.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

saddled.en: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

sadducee.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees, which say that there is no resurrection, and asked him,
Then come unto him the Sadducees, which say there is no resurrection; and they asked him, saying,

sadly.en: And he asked Pharaoh’s officers that were with him in the ward of his lord’s house, saying, Wherefore look ye so sadly to day?

sadness.en: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.

safe.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.

safeguard.en: Abide thou with me, fear not: for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life: but with me thou shalt be in safeguard.

safely.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

safety.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

saffron.en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:

sail.en: And when we had launched from thence, we sailed under Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.
And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

sailing.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy; and he put us therein.

sailor.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

saint.en: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

saith.en: He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?
There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

sake.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.

sale.en: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.
Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

salmon.en: And Salmon begat Boaz, and Boaz begat Obed,
And Amminadab begat Nahshon, and Nahshon begat Salmon,

salt.en: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.

saltness.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

salutation.en: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

salute.en: And when ye come into an house, salute it.

salvation.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.

samaritan.en: And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan.
Then answered the Jews, and said unto him, Say we not well that thou art a Samaritan, and hast a devil?

same.en: The same was in the beginning with God.

samson.en: Then went Samson to Gaza, and saw there an harlot, and went in unto her.
And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

sanctification.en: That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour;
For this is the will of God, even your sanctification, that ye should abstain from fornication:

sanctified.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.
For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

sanctify.en: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

sanctuary.en: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

sand.en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.

sandal.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
And the angel said unto him, Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals. And so he did. And he saith unto him, Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.

sang.en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

sank.en: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

sap.en: The trees of the LORD are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

sapphire.en: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

sardine.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

sardius.en: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

sardonyx.en: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

sat.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.
Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

satan.en: For some are already turned aside after Satan.
And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

satiate.en: For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.

satisfaction.en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

satisfy.en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

satyr.en: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

saul.en: And Saul eyed David from that day and forward.
Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:

save.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
Save, LORD: let the king hear us when we call.

saving.en: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

saviour.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
I, even I, am the LORD; and beside me there is no saviour.

saviours.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the LORD’s.

Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.

savour.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned?
For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish:

savourest.en: But he turned, and said unto Peter, Get thee behind me, Satan: thou art an offence unto me: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but those that be of men.
But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

savours.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven, and pray for the life of the king, and of his sons.

savoury.en: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

saw.en: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption.

say.en: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

saying.en: And God spake unto Noah, saying,
And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,

scab.en: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

scabbard.en: O thou sword of the LORD, how long will it be ere thou be quiet? put up thyself into thy scabbard, rest, and be still.

scabbed.en: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

scaffold.en: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

scale.en: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

scall.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

scalp.en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.

scant.en: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and the scant measure that is abominable?

scapegoat.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

scar.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

scarce.en: And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them.
And when we had sailed slowly many days, and scarce were come over against Cnidus, the wind not suffering us, we sailed under Crete, over against Salmone;

scarcely.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

scarceness.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

scarlet.en: And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe.
And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

scatter.en: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.
A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.

scattered.en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

scattering.en: And the LORD shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.

scent.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

sceptre.en: The LORD hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom is a right sceptre.

schism.en: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.

scholar.en: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
The LORD will cut off the man that doeth this, the master and the scholar, out of the tabernacles of Jacob, and him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.

school.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.

schoolmaster.en: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

science.en: O Timothy, keep that which is committed to thy trust, avoiding profane and vain babblings, and oppositions of science falsely so called:

Children in whom was no blemish, but well favoured, and skilful in all wisdom, and cunning in knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability in them to stand in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans.

scoff.en: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

scoffer.en: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

scorch.en: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.

scorn.en: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

scorner.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

scornful.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
Wherefore hear the word of the LORD, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.

scorpion.en: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to hurt men five months.

scoured.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.

scourge.en: Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him.
If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

scrabble.en: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

scrap.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

scrape.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
And they shall destroy the walls of Tyrus, and break down her towers: I will also scrape her dust from her, and make her like the top of a rock.

screech.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.

scribe.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?
Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

scrip.en: Carry neither purse, nor scrip, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way.
Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

scripture.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
(Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

scroll.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

scum.en: She hath wearied herself with lies, and her great scum went not forth out of her: her scum shall be in the fire.
Then set it empty upon the coals thereof, that the brass of it may be hot, and may burn, and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it, that the scum of it may be consumed.

scurvy.en: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

scythian.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

sea.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

seafaring.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee, and say to thee, How art thou destroyed, that wast inhabited of seafaring men, the renowned city, which wast strong in the sea, she and her inhabitants, which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it!

seal.en: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

seam.en: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

search.en: O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known me.
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

searching.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

seared.en: Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron;

season.en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

seat.en: And he drave them from the judgment seat.
Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

sebat.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

second.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.
Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

secondarily.en: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

secret.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.

secretly.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

sect.en: But we desire to hear of thee what thou thinkest: for as concerning this sect, we know that every where it is spoken against.
Which knew me from the beginning, if they would testify, that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

secure.en: And if this come to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him, and secure you.
The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

securely.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy: ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war.

security.en: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.

sedition.en: (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.)
Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

seduce.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

seducer.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

seducing.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils;

see.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God.
The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

seed.en: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

seedtime.en: While the earth remaineth, seedtime and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.

seeing.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
For ye suffer fools gladly, seeing ye yourselves are wise.

seek.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

seem.en: Even so, Father: for so it seemed good in thy sight.
That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

seemly.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

seen.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,
And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

seer.en: And the LORD spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,
Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer’s house is.

seeth.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

seethe.en: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
Take the choice of the flock, and burn also the bones under it, and make it boil well, and let them seethe the bones of it therein.

seize.en: Then ye shall rise up from the ambush, and seize upon the city: for the LORD your God will deliver it into your hand.
Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

selah.en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

self.en: And now, O Father, glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was.
But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man’s judgment: yea, I judge not mine own self.

selfsame.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and Ishmael his son.

sell.en: And Jacob said, Sell me this day thy birthright.
Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.

seller.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.
The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.

selvedge.en: And he made loops of blue on the edge of one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling: likewise he made in the uttermost side of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

selves.en: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.

senate.en: And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

senator.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

send.en: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you:

sens.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

sense.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense, and caused them to understand the reading.

sensual.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

sent.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

sentence.en: And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required.
A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

separate.en: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

separating.en: And to speak unto the priests which were in the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying, Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?

separation.en: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD.
All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

sepulchre.en: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.
Their quiver is as an open sepulchre, they are all mighty men.

seraphim.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

sere.en: And the sons of Zebulun; Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel.
Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

serjeant.en: And when it was day, the magistrates sent the serjeants, saying, Let those men go.
And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans.

serpent.en: Or if he ask a fish, will he give him a serpent?
And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:

servant.en: And he said, I am Abraham’s servant.
So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

serve.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

service.en: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

servile.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

serving.en: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
Serving the LORD with all humility of mind, and with many tears, and temptations, which befell me by the lying in wait of the Jews:

servitor.en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

servitude.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.
Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

set.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.
Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

sett.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

setter.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.

setting.en: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
And thou shalt set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

settle.en: For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.
Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

seven.en: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
He had also seven sons and three daughters.

sevenfold.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

seventeen.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

seventeenth.en: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

seventh.en: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

seventy.en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.
And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

sever.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,

several.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

severally.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.

severity.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

sew.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

shade.en: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

shadow.en: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away.

shadowing.en: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.

shadrach.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, in the province of Babylon.
And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

shady.en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.

shaft.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
And he made the candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work made he the candlestick; his shaft, and his branch, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, were of the same:

shake.en: The suburbs shall shake at the sound of the cry of thy pilots.
And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

shaken.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall, and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken.
That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

shall.en: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.

sham.en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.
The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

shama.en: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,

shamble.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

shame.en: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.
Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.

shameful.en: Thou art filled with shame for glory: drink thou also, and let thy foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’s right hand shall be turned unto thee, and shameful spewing shall be on thy glory.

For according to the number of thy cities were thy gods, O Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have ye set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

shamer.en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

shape.en: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.

share.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines, to sharpen every man his share, and his coulter, and his axe, and his mattock.

sharp.en: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.

sharpen.en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

sharper.en: The best of them is as a brier: the most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen and thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

sharply.en: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
And the men of Ephraim said unto him, Why hast thou served us thus, that thou calledst us not, when thou wentest to fight with the Midianites? And they did chide with him sharply.

sharpness.en: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

shave.en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;
Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

she.en: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
Then came she and worshipped him, saying, Lord, help me.

sheaf.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

sheal.en: And of the sons of Bani; Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub, and Sheal, and Ramoth.

shear.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep.
And Laban went to shear his sheep: and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father’s.

shearer.en: Shall I then take my bread, and my water, and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers, and give it unto men, whom I know not whence they be?
The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth:

shearing.en: And he arose and departed, and came to Samaria. And as he was at the shearing house in the way,
And he said, Take them alive. And they took them alive, and slew them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

sheath.en: And the LORD commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.

sheave.en: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

shed.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

shedder.en: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth the like to any one of these things,

shedding.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

sheep.en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

sheepcot.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.

sheepcote.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Israel:

Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:

sheepfold.en: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

sheepmaster.en: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Israel an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

sheepskin.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

sheet.en: And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending unto him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth:
But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.

shekel.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

shelter.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

shepherd.en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD;

sherd.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out, and thou shalt break the sherds thereof, and pluck off thine own breasts: for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.

And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.

sheriff.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

sheth.en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

shew.en: And the LORD shewed me four carpenters.
Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

shewbread.en: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

shibboleth.en: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

shield.en: Order ye the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

shiloh.en: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
Then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

shin.en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

shine.en: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

shining.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
He was a burning and a shining light: and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light.

ship.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
And when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.

shipmaster.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him, What meanest thou, O sleeper? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.

shipping.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus.

shipwreck.en: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:
Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

shittah.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:

shittim.en: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

shiver.en: And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father.

shock.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
