And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

suit.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

sum.en: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!
Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

summer.en: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.

sun.en: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

sunder.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
For now will I break his yoke from off thee, and will burst thy bonds in sunder.

sundry.en: God, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

sung.en: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

sunk.en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength, and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.

sunrising.en: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

sup.en: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me.

superfluity.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

superfluous.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

superscription.en: And he saith unto them, Whose is this image and superscription?
And the superscription of his accusation was written over, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

superstition.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition, and of one Jesus, which was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

superstitious.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.

supper.en: Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many:
When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.

supplant.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?

supple.en: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

suppliant.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.

supplication.en: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

supply.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

support.en: Now we exhort you, brethren, warn them that are unruly, comfort the feebleminded, support the weak, be patient toward all men.
I have shewed you all things, how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, how he said, It is more blessed to give than to receive.

suppose.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

supreme.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

sure.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.

surely.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
Whosoever lieth with a beast shall surely be put to death.

suretiship.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.

surety.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

surfeit.en: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.

surmising.en: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

surname.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark.

surprise.en: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

sustain.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

sustained.en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.

sustenance.en: Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance.
Now Barzillai was a very aged man, even fourscore years old: and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim; for he was a very great man.

swaddle.en: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple thee; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD’s anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

swaddling.en: And this shall be a sign unto you; Ye shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a manger.
And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a manger; because there was no room for them in the inn.

swallow.en: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.

swan.en: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

sware.en: The oath which he sware to our father Abraham,
So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

swarm.en: And the LORD did according to the word of Moses; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, from his servants, and from his people; there remained not one.
And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

swear.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.
And though they say, The LORD liveth; surely they swear falsely.

swearer.en: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me, saith the LORD of hosts.

swearing.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

sweat.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.
They shall have linen bonnets upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.

sweep.en: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the LORD of hosts.
Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, doth not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it?

sweeping.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.

sweet.en: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

sweetly.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth down sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.

sweetness.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.

swell.en: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

swelling.en: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.

swept.en: And when he cometh, he findeth it swept and garnished.
Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.

swerve.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

swift.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

swifter.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

swiftly.en: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.
And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:

swim.en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
And the soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, lest any of them should swim out, and escape.

swine.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding.
Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

swollen.en: Howbeit they looked when he should have swollen, or fallen down dead suddenly: but after they had looked a great while, and saw no harm come to him, they changed their minds, and said that he was a god.

swoon.en: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

sword.en: Ye Ethiopians also, ye shall be slain by my sword.
And he killed James the brother of John with the sword.

sworn.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

sycamine.en: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

synagogue.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.
And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

syracuse.en: And landing at Syracuse, we tarried there three days.

syrian.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Israel, they gathered themselves together.

taber.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

tabernacle.en: Now the Jews’ feast of tabernacles was at hand.
How amiable are thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

table.en: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

tablet.en: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,

We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.

tabor.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor.
The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

tabret.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

tache.en: And he made fifty taches of brass to couple the tent together, that it might be one.
The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,

tackling.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship.
Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.

taha.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

tail.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.

take.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

taken.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

taker.en: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

taking.en: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature?

tale.en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
Go therefore now, and work; for there shall no straw be given you, yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks.

talebearer.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

talent.en: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
Of a talent of pure gold made he it, and all the vessels thereof.

tales.en: And their words seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not.
In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

talk.en: And Abram fell on his face: and God talked with him, saying,
Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

talker.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

Therefore prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the residue of the heathen, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and are an infamy of the people:

talking.en: And he left off talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

tall.en: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

tame.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and hath been tamed of mankind:

tammuz.en: Then he brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’s house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat women weeping for Tammuz.

tanner.en: And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.
He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.

tapestry.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

tar.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.

tare.en: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

target.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

tarry.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas.
But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

tarsus.en: Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, for to seek Saul:
Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus.

tartan.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;

And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

task.en: And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.
And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case, after it was said, Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task.

taskmaster.en: And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people, and their officers, saying,
And the taskmasters hasted them, saying, Fulfil your works, your daily tasks, as when there was straw.

taste.en: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

tattler.en: And withal they learn to be idle, wandering about from house to house; and not only idle, but tattlers also and busybodies, speaking things which they ought not.

taught.en: And he opened his mouth, and taught them, saying,
And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all.

taunt.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that are round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken it.

taunting.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

tavern.en: And from thence, when the brethren heard of us, they came to meet us as far as Appii forum, and The three taverns: whom when Paul saw, he thanked God, and took courage.

tax.en: And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city.
To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child.

taxation.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh: he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, of every one according to his taxation, to give it unto Pharaohnechoh.

teach.en: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

teacher.en: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?

teaching.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

tear.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

teat.en: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
Thus thou calledst to remembrance the lewdness of thy youth, in bruising thy teats by the Egyptians for the paps of thy youth.

tebeth.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his reign.

tedious.en: Notwithstanding, that I be not further tedious unto thee, I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words.

teeth.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

teil.en: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.

tell.en: And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.
I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

telling.en: And charged the messenger, saying, When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

And it was so, when Gideon heard the telling of the dream, and the interpretation thereof, that he worshipped, and returned into the host of Israel, and said, Arise; for the LORD hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian.

temper.en: And thou shalt prepare a meat offering for it every morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of an hin of oil, to temper with the fine flour; a meat offering continually by a perpetual ordinance unto the LORD.

temperance.en: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

temperate.en: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

tempered.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:

tempest.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.
So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

tempestuous.en: But not long after there arose against it a tempestuous wind, called Euroclydon.
Then said they unto him, What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us? for the sea wrought, and was tempestuous.

temple.en: But he spake of the temple of his body.
And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.

temporal.en: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.

tempt.en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the LORD.

temptation.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations.
My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations;

tempter.en: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.
For this cause, when I could no longer forbear, I sent to know your faith, lest by some means the tempter have tempted you, and our labour be in vain.

tempting.en: And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven.
Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

ten.en: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:

tend.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

tender.en: Leah was tender eyed; but Rachel was beautiful and well favoured.
The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

tenderness.en: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

tenon.en: One board had two tenons, equally distant one from another: thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

tenor.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.

And they said, The man asked us straitly of our state, and of our kindred, saying, Is your father yet alive? have ye another brother? and we told him according to the tenor of these words: could we certainly know that he would say, Bring your brother down?

tent.en: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

tenth.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

tentmaker.en: And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers.

teraphim.en: And the man Micah had an house of gods, and made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
And the priest’s heart was glad, and he took the ephod, and the teraphim, and the graven image, and went in the midst of the people.

term.en: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzibah, and thy land Beulah: for the LORD delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.

terrace.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the LORD, and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah.

terrestrial.en: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

terrible.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.
Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

terrify.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

terror.en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
Be not a terror unto me: thou art my hope in the day of evil.

testament.en: By so much was Jesus made a surety of a better testament.
Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

testator.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.

testify.en: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.

testimony.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
Even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

tetrarch.en: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard of the fame of Jesus,
But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip’s wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done,

than.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:

thank.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

thankful.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

thanksgiving.en: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

thankworthy.en: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

that.en: I am that bread of life.
Judge not, that ye be not judged.

theatre.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.

thee.en: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.

theft.en: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:
Neither repented they of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their fornication, nor of their thefts.

their.en: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
Destruction and misery are in their ways:

them.en: So Paul departed from among them.
He said, Bring them hither to me.

themselves.en: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

thence.en: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.

thenceforth.en: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

there.en: And many believed on him there.
And there they preached the gospel.

thereabout.en: And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments:

thereat.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

thereby.en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
And Hamath also shall border thereby; Tyrus, and Zidon, though it be very wise.

therefore.en: Be not ye therefore partakers with them.
Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.

therefrom.en: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Israel to sin; he departed not therefrom.

therein.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

thereinto.en: Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.

thereof.en: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.

thereon.en: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as the LORD commanded Moses.
And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

thereout.en: But God clave an hollow place that was in the jaw, and there came water thereout; and when he had drunk, his spirit came again, and he revived: wherefore he called the name thereof Enhakkore, which is in Lehi unto this day.

And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:

thereto.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.

thereunto.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold, and made thereunto a crown of gold round about.
That no man should be moved by these afflictions: for yourselves know that we are appointed thereunto.

thereupon.en: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

therewith.en: And having food and raiment let us be therewith content.
But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the LORD.

these.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.

thessalonian.en: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

they.en: And they glorified God in me.

thick.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
Then spake Solomon, The LORD said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

thicket.en: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.

thickness.en: The chambers were in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.
The thickness of the wall, which was for the side chamber without, was five cubits: and that which was left was the place of the side chambers that were within.

thief.en: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

thieve.en: The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth.
All that ever came before me are thieves and robbers: but the sheep did not hear them.

thigh.en: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
And as he passed over Penuel the sun rose upon him, and he halted upon his thigh.

thin.en: And, behold, seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them.
And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:

thine.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

thing.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.

think.en: What think ye? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.

thinking.en: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except thou take away the blind and the lame, thou shalt not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

third.en: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
And it was the third hour, and they crucified him.

thirdly.en: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.

thirst.en: In that day shall the fair virgins and young men faint for thirst.
They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

thirsty.en: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

thirteen.en: And Bethlebaoth, and Sharuhen; thirteen cities and their villages:
But Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.

thirteenth.en: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

thirtieth.en: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Judah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

thirty.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.

this.en: Give us this day our daily bread.
And this will we do, if God permit.

thistle.en: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?
Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

thither.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

thitherward.en: And they turned thitherward, and came to the house of the young man the Levite, even unto the house of Micah, and saluted him.
They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to the LORD in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

thong.en: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

thorn.en: As the lily among thorns, so is my love among the daughters.
And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

thoroughly.en: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them thoroughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

those.en: Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.
In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

though.en: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.

thought.en: I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.
When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

thousand.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

thread.en: And afterward came out his brother, that had the scarlet thread upon his hand: and his name was called Zarah.
Thy lips are like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech is comely: thy temples are like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.

threaten.en: But that it spread no further among the people, let us straitly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name.
Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously:

threatening.en: And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest,
And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word,

three.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

threefold.en: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

thresh.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.
And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

threshold.en: Then the glory of the LORD departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.
Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the ward at the thresholds of the gates.

threw.en: And as they cried out, and cast off their clothes, and threw dust into the air,
And there came a certain poor widow, and she threw in two mites, which make a farthing.

thrice.en: This was done thrice: and the vessel was received up again into heaven.
For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

throat.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

throne.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom.
Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

throng.en: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.
And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

through.en: And he must needs go through Samaria.
And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho.

throughly.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

throughout.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

throw.en: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, and throw down all thy strong holds:
And he said, Throw her down. So they threw her down: and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trode her under foot.

throwing.en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

thrown.en: Therefore on that day he called him Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal plead against him, because he hath thrown down his altar.
And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.

thrust.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

thumb.en: But Adonibezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

thummim.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

thunder.en: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.
At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

thunderbolt.en: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

thundering.en: Intreat the LORD (for it is enough) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail; and I will let you go, and ye shall stay no longer.
And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

thus.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel.
Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.

thy.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
For mine eyes have seen thy salvation,

thyself.en: Save thyself, and come down from the cross.
And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

tidal.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations;
With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam, and with Tidal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings with five.

tidings.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers,

tie.en: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as the LORD commanded Moses.

tile.en: Thou also, son of man, take thee a tile, and lay it before thee, and pourtray upon it the city, even Jerusalem:

tiling.en: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.

till.en: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph.

tillage.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

tiller.en: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

timber.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

timbrel.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

time.en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

timothy.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

tin.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:

tingle.en: And the LORD said to Samuel, Behold, I will do a thing in Israel, at which both the ears of every one that heareth it shall tingle.
Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah, that whosoever heareth of it, both his ears shall tingle.

tinkling.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,

tip.en: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.

tire.en: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
And your tires shall be upon your heads, and your shoes upon your feet: ye shall not mourn nor weep; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities, and mourn one toward another.

tired.en: And when Jehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her face, and tired her head, and looked out at a window.

tith.en: I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.
And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

tithe.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.
Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

tithing.en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year, which is the year of tithing, and hast given it unto the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, that they may eat within thy gates, and be filled;

title.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

tittle.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail.
For verily I say unto you, Till heaven and earth pass, one jot or one tittle shall in no wise pass from the law, till all be fulfilled.

to.en: Neither give place to the devil.
He said, Bring them hither to me.

toe.en: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

together.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

toil.en: And why take ye thought for raiment? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they toil not, neither do they spin:
And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, said he, hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.

token.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
But if this thing be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel:

tola.en: And the sons of Issachar; Tola, and Phuvah, and Job, and Shimron.
Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom, four.

told.en: Behold, I have told you before.
And they told to Mordecai Esther’s words.

tolerable.en: But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you.
But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city.

toll.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid unto them.
Be it known now unto the king, that, if this city be builded, and the walls set up again, then will they not pay toll, tribute, and custom, and so thou shalt endamage the revenue of the kings.

tomb.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

tomorrow.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

tongs.en: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

tongue.en: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

too.en: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.

took.en: And he took it, and did eat before them.
And they laid their hands on him, and took him.

tool.en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the LORD thy God, an altar of stones: thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them.
And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.

tooth.en: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
Ye have heard that it hath been said, An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth:

top.en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

topaz.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

toph.en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the children of Hinnom, that no man might make his son or his daughter to pass through the fire to Molech.

tophet.en: Thus will I do unto this place, saith the LORD, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither the LORD had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’s house; and said to all the people,

torch.en: Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons.
The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

torment.en: And saying, Lord, my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, grievously tormented.
For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment.

tormentor.en: And his lord was wroth, and delivered him to the tormentors, till he should pay all that was due unto him.

torn.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
And the one went out from me, and I said, Surely he is torn in pieces; and I saw him not since:

tortoise.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

torture.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

toss.en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest, the next day they lightened the ship;

tossing.en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

totter.en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

touch.en: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

touching.en: And touching the house of the king of Judah, say, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

tow.en: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.

toward.en: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is toward me.
And Abram journeyed, going on still toward the south.

towel.en: He riseth from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself.
After that he poureth water into a bason, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

tower.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.

town.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

trade.en: And ye shall dwell with us: and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade ye therein, and get you possessions therein.
And the men are shepherds, for their trade hath been to feed cattle; and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.

traded.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

trading.en: And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading.

tradition.en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.
But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?

trafficker.en: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?

train.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

traitor.en: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.

trample.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

trance.en: And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance,
And it came to pass, that, when I was come again to Jerusalem, even while I prayed in the temple, I was in a trance;

tranquillity.en: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.

transfigure.en: And was transfigured before them: and his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

transform.en: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.

transgress.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

transgression.en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.
Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

transgressor.en: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

translate.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.

translation.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because God had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased God.

transparent.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

trap.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

traps.en: Know for a certainty that the LORD your God will no more drive out any of these nations from before you; but they shall be snares and traps unto you, and scourges in your sides, and thorns in your eyes, until ye perish from off this good land which the LORD your God hath given you.

travail.en: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

travel.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul’s companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

traversing.en: How canst thou say, I am not polluted, I have not gone after Baalim? see thy way in the valley, know what thou hast done: thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

treacherous.en: And the LORD said unto me, The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah.
Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

treachery.en: And Joram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, O Ahaziah.

tread.en: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn.
Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

treader.en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.

treason.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?

And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

treasure.en: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

treasurer.en: Thus saith the Lord GOD of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

treasury.en: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries.

treatise.en: The former treatise have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach,

tree.en: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.
Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

tremble.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

trembling.en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

trench.en: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
For the days shall come upon thee, that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

trespass.en: And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

trial.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

tribe.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

tribulation.en: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

tributary.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.

tribute.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no?
Shew me the tribute money. And they brought unto him a penny.

trickle.en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,

tried.en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

triumph.en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

triumphing.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

trodden.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

trode.en: And so it fell out unto him: for the people trode upon him in the gate, and he died.
Thus they inclosed the Benjamites round about, and chased them, and trode them down with ease over against Gibeah toward the sunrising.

troop.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

trouble.en: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

troubler.en: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.

troublous.en: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

trough.en: And she hasted, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again unto the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came and drew water, and filled the troughs to water their father’s flock.

trow.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I trow not.

trucebreaker.en: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

true.en: If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true.
I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.

truly.en: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

trump.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:

trumpet.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

trumpeter.en: And all the congregation worshipped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded: and all this continued until the burnt offering was finished.

And when she looked, behold, the king stood by a pillar, as the manner was, and the princes and the trumpeters by the king, and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew with trumpets: and Athaliah rent her clothes, and cried, Treason, Treason.

trumpets.en: And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.

trust.en: And in his name shall the Gentiles trust.
What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

trusting.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

trusty.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

truth.en: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.
And because I tell you the truth, ye believe me not.

try.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

trying.en: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience.

tubal.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

tumble.en: And when Gideon was come, behold, there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow, and said, Behold, I dreamed a dream, and, lo, a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian, and came unto a tent, and smote it that it fell, and overturned it, that the tent lay along.

tumult.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

tumultuous.en: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the LORD of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.

turn.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
For some are already turned aside after Satan.

turning.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
And the doors had two leaves apiece, two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other door.

turtle.en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

turtledove.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

tutor.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

twain.en: And whosoever shall compel thee to go a mile, go with him twain.
And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.

twelfth.en: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

twelve.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
And all the men were about twelve.

twentieth.en: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,

twenty.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.
The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

twice.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

twig.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs, and carried it into a land of traffick; he set it in a city of merchants.

Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one, and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent:

twilight.en: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

twin.en: Thy two breasts are like two young roes that are twins.
All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

twinkling.en: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

two.en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.
The men of Bethazmaveth, forty and two.

twofold.en: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

tyre.en: And king Solomon sent and fetched Hiram out of Tyre.
Then Jesus went thence, and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon.

unaccustomed.en: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus; Thou hast chastised me, and I was chastised, as a bullock unaccustomed to the yoke: turn thou me, and I shall be turned; for thou art the LORD my God.

unawares.en: And Jacob stole away unawares to Laban the Syrian, in that he told him not that he fled.
Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

unbelief.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

unbeliever.en: But brother goeth to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.
Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

unbelieving.en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.

uncertain.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in uncertain riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

uncertainly.en: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

uncircumcised.en: Saying, Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised, and didst eat with them.
Whom dost thou pass in beauty? go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.

uncircumcision.en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

uncle.en: And Saul’s uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:

unclean.en: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

unclothed.en: For we that are in this tabernacle do groan, being burdened: not for that we would be unclothed, but clothed upon, that mortality might be swallowed up of life.

uncomely.en: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

uncorruptible.en: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

uncover.en: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
And he drank of the wine, and was drunken; and he was uncovered within his tent.

unction.en: But ye have an unction from the Holy One, and ye know all things.

under.en: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

undergird.en: Which when they had taken up, they used helps, undergirding the ship; and, fearing lest they should fall into the quicksands, strake sail, and so were driven.

underneath.en: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

undersetter.en: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

understand.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.

understanding.en: And Jesus said, Are ye also yet without understanding?
Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

understood.en: They understood not that he spake to them of the Father.
And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them.

undertake.en: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O LORD, I am oppressed; undertake for me.

undertook.en: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

undo.en: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict thee: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

undone.en: As the LORD commanded Moses his servant, so did Moses command Joshua, and so did Joshua; he left nothing undone of all that the LORD commanded Moses.
Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

undress.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

unequal.en: Yet ye say, The way of the LORD is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel; Is not my way equal? are not your ways unequal?
Yet saith the house of Israel, The way of the LORD is not equal. O house of Israel, are not my ways equal? are not your ways unequal?

unequally.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?

unfaithful.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.

unfeigned.en: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:
