unfruitful.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.

ungird.en: And the man came into the house: and he ungirded his camels, and gave straw and provender for the camels, and water to wash his feet, and the men’s feet that were with him.

ungodly.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

unholy.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

unicorn.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

unite.en: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

united.en: O my soul, come not thou into their secret; unto their assembly, mine honour, be not thou united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

unity.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

unjust.en: And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge saith.
When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.

unknown.en: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.

unlade.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

unlawful.en: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

And he said unto them, Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean.

unlearned.en: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:

unleavened.en: Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed.
Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover.

unless.en: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

unloose.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

unmarry.en: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

unmerciful.en: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

unperfect.en: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

unreasonable.en: And that we may be delivered from unreasonable and wicked men: for all men have not faith.
For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner, and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him.

unrighteous.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

unripe.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

unruly.en: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

unsatiable.en: Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians, because thou wast unsatiable; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet couldest not be satisfied.

unsearchable.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

unseemly.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;

And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

unspeakable.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.
How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

unspotted.en: Pure religion and undefiled before God and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

unstable.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father’s bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.

untemper.en: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and there was no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered morter:
And her prophets have daubed them with untempered morter, seeing vanity, and divining lies unto them, saying, Thus saith the Lord GOD, when the LORD hath not spoken.

until.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool.
But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.

untimely.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

unto.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
And God spake unto Noah, saying,

untoward.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation.

unwashen.en: These are the things which defile a man: but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man.
And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

unweighed.en: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

unwise.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

unworthy.en: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

up.en: And he went up from thence to Beersheba.
Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

upbraid.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done, because they repented not:
If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

upheld.en: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.

uphold.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

upon.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar.
I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

upper.en: And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished: there make ready.
And there were many lights in the upper chamber, where they were gathered together.

uppermost.en: And the chief seats in the synagogues, and the uppermost rooms at feasts:
And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

upright.en: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
Righteous art thou, O LORD, and upright are thy judgments.

uprightly.en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.

uprightness.en: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.
Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

uprising.en: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

uproar.en: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar of the people.
But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

upside.en: The LORD preserveth the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down.
Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

upward.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
Fifteen cubits upward did the waters prevail; and the mountains were covered.

ur.en: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.

urbane.en: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

urge.en: And when the man rose up to depart, his father in law urged him: therefore he lodged there again.
And it came to pass, when she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him, so that his soul was vexed unto death;

urgent.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

urim.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
And when Saul enquired of the LORD, the LORD answered him not, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.

us.en: Give us this day our daily bread.

use.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

usurer.en: If thou lend money to any of my people that is poor by thee, thou shalt not be to him as an usurer, neither shalt thou lay upon him usury.

usurp.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.

usury.en: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

utmost.en: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all that are in the utmost corners,
And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,

utter.en: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

utterance.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.

utterly.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

uttermost.en: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
Verily I say unto thee, Thou shalt by no means come out thence, till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing.

vagabond.en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.

vail.en: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

vain.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

vainglory.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

vainly.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

vale.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim, which is the salt sea.
And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

valiant.en: Why are thy valiant men swept away? they stood not, because the LORD did drive them.
Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.

valley.en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.
So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.

valour.en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men; all these were men of valour.
And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

value.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.

valued.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

vanish.en: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

vanity.en: Then I returned, and I saw vanity under the sun.
Vanity of vanities, saith the preacher; all is vanity.

vapour.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

vapours.en: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapours; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

variableness.en: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and cometh down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

variance.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
For I am come to set a man at variance against his father, and the daughter against her mother, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.

vat.en: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.

vaunt.en: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
And the LORD said unto Gideon, The people that are with thee are too many for me to give the Midianites into their hands, lest Israel vaunt themselves against me, saying, Mine own hand hath saved me.

vehement.en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.

And it came to pass, when the sun did arise, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and wished in himself to die, and said, It is better for me to die than to live.

vehemently.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him.
But he spake the more vehemently, If I should die with thee, I will not deny thee in any wise. Likewise also said they all.

veil.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.
And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst.

vein.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

vengeance.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

venison.en: And Isaac loved Esau, because he did eat of his venison: but Rebekah loved Jacob.
Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the LORD before my death.

venom.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

venomous.en: And when the barbarians saw the venomous beast hang on his hand, they said among themselves, No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he hath escaped the sea, yet vengeance suffereth not to live.

vent.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

venture.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn thine hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn thine hand, that thou mayest carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verify.en: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.
But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

verily.en: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.

verity.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.

vermilion.en: And that she increased her whoredoms: for when she saw men pourtrayed upon the wall, the images of the Chaldeans pourtrayed with vermilion,
That saith, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

very.en: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

vessel.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

vestment.en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

vestry.en: And he said unto him that was over the vestry, Bring forth vestments for all the worshippers of Baal. And he brought them forth vestments.

vesture.en: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.

vex.en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

vexation.en: Better is an handful with quietness, than both the hands full with travail and vexation of spirit.
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

vexed.en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.

vial.en: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

victory.en: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

victual.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
And those officers provided victual for king Solomon, and for all that came unto king Solomon’s table, every man in his month: they lacked nothing.

victuals.en: And the men took of their victuals, and asked not counsel at the mouth of the LORD.
Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

view.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.

vigilant.en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:
A bishop then must be blameless, the husband of one wife, vigilant, sober, of good behaviour, given to hospitality, apt to teach;

vile.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

village.en: Ekron, with her towns and her villages:
Cain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten cities with their villages:

villany.en: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the LORD, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

Because they have committed villany in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours’ wives, and have spoken lying words in my name, which I have not commanded them; even I know, and am a witness, saith the LORD.

vine.en: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
Then said the trees unto the vine, Come thou, and reign over us.

vinedresser.en: But the captain of the guard left of the poor of the land to be vinedressers and husbandmen.
But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left certain of the poor of the land for vinedressers and for husbandmen.

vinegar.en: And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar,
They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.

vineyard.en: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
And Noah began to be an husbandman, and he planted a vineyard:

vintage.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.

viol.en: Take thou away from me the noise of thy songs; for I will not hear the melody of thy viols.
That chant to the sound of the viol, and invent to themselves instruments of musick, like David;

violate.en: Her priests have violated my law, and have profaned mine holy things: they have put no difference between the holy and profane, neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I am profaned among them.

violence.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

violent.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

violently.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
And Abraham reproved Abimelech because of a well of water, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

viper.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
Ye serpents, ye generation of vipers, how can ye escape the damnation of hell?

virgin.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.

virginity.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
But if this thing be true, and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel:

virtue.en: And Jesus said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

virtuous.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

visage.en: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

visible.en: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

vision.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

visit.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he hath visited and redeemed his people,

visitation.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

visiting.en: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

vocation.en: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called,

voice.en: The voice of the LORD divideth the flames of fire.
And Jesus cried with a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.

void.en: It is time for thee, LORD, to work: for they have made void thy law.
For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

volume.en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

voluntarily.en: Now when the prince shall prepare a voluntary burnt offering or peace offerings voluntarily unto the LORD, one shall then open him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt offering and his peace offerings, as he did on the sabbath day: then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.

voluntary.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

vomit.en: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.

vow.en: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

voyage.en: And said unto them, Sirs, I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage, not only of the lading and ship, but also of our lives.

vulture.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

wafer.en: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the LORD:
And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

wag.en: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

wages.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

wagon.en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

wail.en: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through thee, saith the LORD.
And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.

wait.en: I have waited for thy salvation, O LORD.
And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah.

waiting.en: So that ye come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ:
And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patient waiting for Christ.

wake.en: Who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.
And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

waken.en: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

waking.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

walk.en: (For we walk by faith, not by sight:)
Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

walking.en: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

wall.en: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

wallow.en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.
Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the LORD: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

wander.en: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.
Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

wanderer.en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

wandering.en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?
As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.

want.en: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

wanting.en: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

wanton.en: But the younger widows refuse: for when they have begun to wax wanton against Christ, they will marry;
Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

wantonness.en: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

war.en: The LORD is a man of war: the LORD is his name.
Joshua made war a long time with all those kings.

ward.en: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
And he put them all together into ward three days.

wardrobe.en: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.

ware.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice.

wares.en: Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
Damascus was thy merchant in the multitude of the wares of thy making, for the multitude of all riches; in the wine of Helbon, and white wool.

warfare.en: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;)
This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

warm.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

warming.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself, she looked upon him, and said, And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth.

warn.en: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

warning.en: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
Son of man, I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel: therefore hear the word at my mouth, and give them warning from me.

warp.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

warre.en: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

warrior.en: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.

And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

was.en: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
And the famine was sore in the land.

wash.en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
But thou, when thou fastest, anoint thine head, and wash thy face;

washed.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

washing.en: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

washpot.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

wast.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

waste.en: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

wasteness.en: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

waster.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

wasting.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.

watch.en: And sitting down they watched him there;
And what I say unto you I say unto all, Watch.

watcher.en: I saw in the visions of my head upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven;
Make ye mention to the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, that watchers come from a far country, and give out their voice against the cities of Judah.

watches.en: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.
When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

watchful.en: Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found thy works perfect before God.

watchman.en: For thus hath the LORD said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will enquire, enquire ye: return, come.

watchtower.en: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:

water.en: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:

watercourse.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

waterflood.en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

watering.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
The Lord then answered him, and said, Thou hypocrite, doth not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering?

waterpot.en: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
Jesus saith unto them, Fill the waterpots with water. And they filled them up to the brim.

waterspout.en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

wave.en: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

waved.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD; as Moses commanded.
And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD.

waver.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

wax.en: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
So David waxed greater and greater: for the LORD of hosts was with him.

waxen.en: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore they are become great, and waxen rich.
And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

way.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
And the way of peace have they not known:

wayfaring.en: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
And when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city: and the old man said, Whither goest thou? and whence comest thou?

waymark.en: Set thee up waymarks, make thee high heaps: set thine heart toward the highway, even the way which thou wentest: turn again, O virgin of Israel, turn again to these thy cities.

wayside.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
And when he came, lo, Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching: for his heart trembled for the ark of God. And when the man came into the city, and told it, all the city cried out.

we.en: And this will we do, if God permit.
(For we walk by faith, not by sight:)

weak.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

weaken.en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

weakness.en: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

wealth.en: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

wealthy.en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.
Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwelleth without care, saith the LORD, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

wean.en: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.

weapon.en: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
Wisdom is better than weapons of war: but one sinner destroyeth much good.

wear.en: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together.
But what went ye out for to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? behold, they that wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

weariness.en: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.

wearing.en: Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate saith unto them, Behold the man!
Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

wearisome.en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

weary.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

weasel.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

weather.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
He answered and said unto them, When it is evening, ye say, It will be fair weather: for the sky is red.

weave.en: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

weaver.en: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

web.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.
They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

wedding.en: Then saith he to his servants, The wedding is ready, but they which were bidden were not worthy.
And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding: and they would not come.

wedge.en: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.

When I saw among the spoils a goodly Babylonish garment, and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight, then I coveted them, and took them; and, behold, they are hid in the earth in the midst of my tent, and the silver under it.

wedlock.en: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

weed.en: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.

week.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess.

weep.en: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weepeth and mourneth for Absalom.

weeping.en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

weigh.en: TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.
Let me be weighed in an even balance that God may know mine integrity.

weighing.en: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

weight.en: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

weighty.en: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

welfare.en: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
And he asked them of their welfare, and said, Is your father well, the old man of whom ye spake? Is he yet alive?

well.en: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
Then said the LORD, Doest thou well to be angry?

wellspring.en: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

wen.en: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.

wench.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by Enrogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

went.en: Jesus went unto the mount of Olives.
And every man went unto his own house.

wept.en: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
And Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

were.en: And all the men were about twelve.
And they did all eat, and were filled.

wert.en: I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot: I would thou wert cold or hot.
If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

west.en: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

western.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

westward.en: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

wet.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

Nevertheless leave the stump of his roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth:

whale.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale’s belly; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

what.en: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.

whatsoever.en: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.

wheat.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten: for they were not grown up.
He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

wheaten.en: And unleavened bread, and cakes unleavened tempered with oil, and wafers unleavened anointed with oil: of wheaten flour shalt thou make them.

wheel.en: As for the wheels, it was cried unto them in my hearing, O wheel.
O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

whelp.en: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.

when.en: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
And when ye come into an house, salute it.

whence.en: And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

whensoever.en: For ye have the poor with you always, and whensoever ye will ye may do them good: but me ye have not always.
And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.

where.en: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

whereabout.en: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king hath commanded me a business, and hath said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send thee, and what I have commanded thee: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

whereas.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
For out of prison he cometh to reign; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor.

whereby.en: And he said, LORD God, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it?
Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

wherefore.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.
Wherefore I beseech you, be ye followers of me.

wherein.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

whereinto.en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

whereof.en: This Jesus hath God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses.
The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

whereon.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

wheresoever.en: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Wheresoever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.

whereto.en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

whereunto.en: And again he said, Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God?
But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

whereupon.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatsoever she would ask.

wherewith.en: But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand, wherewith thou shalt do signs.

wherewithal.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to thy word.
Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed?

whet.en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

whether.en: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

which.en: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s.
Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

while.en: But she that liveth in pleasure is dead while she liveth.
While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

whiles.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God;

whilst.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

whip.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

whirl.en: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

whirlwind.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

whisper.en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

whisperer.en: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

whispering.en: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

whit.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.

white.en: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.

whither.en: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

whithersoever.en: Go thee one way or other, either on the right hand, or on the left, whithersoever thy face is set.
And a certain scribe came, and said unto him, Master, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.

who.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

whole.en: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

wholesome.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

wholly.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.

whom.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
He saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am?

whomsoever.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner, whomsoever they desired.
Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Ghost.

whore.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.

whoredom.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

whoremonger.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loveth and maketh a lie.

whorish.en: How weak is thine heart, saith the LORD GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

whose.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

whoso.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me.

whosoever.en: And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.
And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me.

why.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

wicked.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

wickedly.en: And said, I pray you, brethren, do not so wickedly.
Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

wickedness.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

wide.en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.
It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.

wideness.en: And between the chambers was the wideness of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.

widow.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed.
Ye shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

widowhood.en: And she arose, and went away, and laid by her vail from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.

wife.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

wild.en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.
Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

wilderness.en: In the wilderness, Betharabah, Middin, and Secacah,
And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

wile.en: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.

wilfully.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,

will.en: And Abraham said, I will swear.
And this will we do, if God permit.

willing.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spake again to them.

willingly.en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.

willow.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.

wilt.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
And they said unto him, Where wilt thou that we prepare?

wimple.en: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,

win.en: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

wind.en: And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew.
Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

winding.en: The door for the middle chamber was in the right side of the house: and they went up with winding stairs into the middle chamber, and out of the middle into the third.

And there was an enlarging, and a winding about still upward to the side chambers: for the winding about of the house went still upward round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house was still upward, and so increased from the lowest chamber to the highest by the midst.

window.en: And for the house he made windows of narrow lights.
For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

windy.en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

wine.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine.

winebibber.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
The Son of man is come eating and drinking; and ye say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a winebibber, a friend of publicans and sinners!

wing.en: And every one had four faces, and every one had four wings.
Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings,

winged.en: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
And God created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

wink.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

winnow.en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred, with whose maidens thou wast? Behold, he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor.
The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.

winter.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter.
For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over and gone;

wipe.en: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.

wire.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

wisdom.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children.
Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.

wise.en: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

wisely.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and the LORD was with him.

wish.en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

wishing.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

wist.en: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.
And he said unto them, How is it that ye sought me? wist ye not that I must be about my Father’s business?

wit.en: And his sister stood afar off, to wit what would be done to him.
They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wit’s end.

witch.en: Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.
There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch.

witchcraft.en: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers:

with.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.
Greet one another with an holy kiss.

withal.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.

withdraw.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

wither.en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

withered.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.
My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

withhold.en: And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.
Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.

within.en: Our feet shall stand within thy gates, O Jerusalem.
He measured also the porch of the gate within, one reed.

without.en: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

withstand.en: And if one prevail against him, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

withstood.en: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

witness.en: And ye are witnesses of these things.
But neither so did their witness agree together.

wittingly.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

witty.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

wives.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

wizard.en: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.
Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

wo.en: One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

woe.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
One woe is past; and, behold, there come two woes more hereafter.

woeful.en: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow thee: neither have I desired the woeful day; thou knowest: that which came out of my lips was right before thee.

wolf.en: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

wolves.en: Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves.
Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

woman.en: Last of all the woman died also.
And last of all the woman died also.

womankind.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

womb.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?

women.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother:

won.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

wonder.en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.
And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.

wondered.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds.
And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have ye here any meat?

wonderful.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land;
Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

wonders.en: These see the works of the LORD, and his wonders in the deep.
And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

wondrous.en: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.
Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

wont.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.
And he came out, and went, as he was wont, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him.

wood.en: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.

woof.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

wool.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

work.en: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
So then death worketh in us, but life in you.

worker.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

workfellow.en: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

working.en: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

workman.en: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
Nor scrip for your journey, neither two coats, neither shoes, nor yet staves: for the workman is worthy of his meat.

workmanship.en: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
And he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship;

world.en: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

worldly.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

worm.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.
Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

wormwood.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

worse.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to his tent.
But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

worship.en: If thou therefore wilt worship me, all shall be thine.
We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

worst.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen, and they shall possess their houses: I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be defiled.

worth.en: Son of man, prophesy and say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Howl ye, Woe worth the day!
And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

worthily.en: And all the people that were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. The LORD make the woman that is come into thine house like Rachel and like Leah, which two did build the house of Israel: and do thou worthily in Ephratah, and be famous in Bethlehem:

worthy.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation.
Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which ye are called?

wot.en: And now, brethren, I wot that through ignorance ye did it, as did also your rulers.
But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

wotteth.en: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand;

would.en: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

wound.en: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

wove.en: And he brake down the houses of the sodomites, that were by the house of the LORD, where the women wove hangings for the grove.

woven.en: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

wrap.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge asketh for a reward; and the great man, he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up.

wrath.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.
So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

wrathful.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.

wreath.en: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.

wreathen.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold.

wrest.en: Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause.
Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

wrestle.en: And Jacob was left alone; and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day.
And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

wrestling.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

wretched.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
Because thou sayest, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and knowest not that thou art wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked:

wretchedness.en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

wring.en: And it was so: for he rose up early on the morrow, and thrust the fleece together, and wringed the dew out of the fleece, a bowl full of water.
And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

wringing.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.

wrinkle.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

writ.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

write.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
These things write I unto thee, hoping to come unto thee shortly:

writer.en: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek; after thee, Benjamin, among thy people; out of Machir came down governors, and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer.

writing.en: Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.
But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

written.en: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
Pilate answered, What I have written I have written.

wrong.en: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
Nay, ye do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.

wrote.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner:
And again he stooped down, and wrote on the ground.

wroth.en: When God heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Israel:
But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

wrought.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

wrung.en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:

yarn.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

ye.en: For ye are our glory and joy.
Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

yea.en: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

year.en: To preach the acceptable year of the Lord.
And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:

yearly.en: And the man Elkanah, and all his house, went up to offer unto the LORD the yearly sacrifice, and his vow.
That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

yearn.en: And Joseph made haste; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother: and he sought where to weep; and he entered into his chamber, and wept there.

Then spake the woman whose the living child was unto the king, for her bowels yearned upon her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the living child, and in no wise slay it. But the other said, Let it be neither mine nor thine, but divide it.

yell.en: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.
The young lions roared upon him, and yelled, and they made his land waste: his cities are burned without inhabitant.

yellow.en: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

yes.en: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children’s crumbs.

yesterday.en: Wilt thou kill me, as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday?
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

yesternight.en: It is in the power of my hand to do you hurt: but the God of your father spake unto me yesternight, saying, Take thou heed that thou speak not to Jacob either good or bad.

Except the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely thou hadst sent me away now empty. God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked thee yesternight.

yet.en: For John was not yet cast into prison.
But now are they many members, yet but one body.

yield.en: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the ghost.

yielding.en: If the spirit of the ruler rise up against thee, leave not thy place; for yielding pacifieth great offences.
And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.

yoke.en: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

yokefellow.en: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

yonder.en: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the LORD yonder.
Then cometh Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and saith unto the disciples, Sit ye here, while I go and pray yonder.

you.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.

young.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

your.en: In your patience possess ye your souls.
Let all your things be done with charity.

yours.en: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.

youth.en: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up.
They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

youthful.en: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

zeal.en: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.
For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

zealous.en: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.

zif.en: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of the LORD laid, in the month Zif:

And it came to pass in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, in the month Zif, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of the LORD.

zillah.en: And Lamech took unto him two wives: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain was Naamah.

zion.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

zohar.en: And the sons of Simeon; Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman.
And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
